I'd love to wash everything, including dishes and cooking utensils, but space constraints mean I'm only going to use dishes and cutlery. ] || ---------------- || I live alone. I'd love to use a dishwasher, but my kitchen is so small that I've been debating for quite some time. I'd love to wash everything, even dishes and utensils, but space constraints mean I'd rather just use dishes and cutlery. After browsing a few brands of mini dishwashers, I finally bought one! ^^ I chose the Minix because of its compact water supply system, its visible interior, the automatic door-opening feature after washing, and its design. :) <Packaging & Delivery>. The dishwasher and the complimentary detergent were shipped separately, but they arrived together. The box itself wasn't as heavy as I thought! The box itself had a string attached, but it wasn't just there for easy lifting. The packaging was thoughtful: cutting the string allowed the box lid to open, making it easy to remove the dishwasher. The inside of the box was meticulously secured, ensuring no damage during shipping. <Installation>. - Before installation, I opened the water tank at the bottom, and it was easy to open if I wanted to clean it during use. - The product itself wasn't as heavy as I thought, so I had no trouble lifting it by myself. However, when I placed the product on the water tank and tried to connect the drain/water supply, the narrow space made it difficult to connect the drain/water supply pipes on the back of the product. I think it would be easier to connect the drain/water supply pipes to the back of the product first, and then rotate the product to install it! - There's a black cardboard(?) inside the product that holds the tray and other items in place, but at first, it wouldn't come off. I struggled for a while, moving the tray and tilting the cardboard. If you look closely at the picture, the cardboard got caught on the wings at the top of the dishwasher when they were horizontal. If you place the top wings vertically so that the wings can pass through the holes in the cardboard, it will come off easily! <Washing and drying>. - After installation, use is very simple. First, turn on the power, open the drip tray at the front of the water tank, and fill it with water. Thanks to the protrusions inside the drip tray, I was amazed that even when I turned on the water, not a single drop splashed out! However, sink faucets usually use both a single-stream mode and a shower mode. In shower mode, water would splash. When I turn it on in single-stream mode, even if I turn on the sink water really hard, it doesn't splash at all. - There are several washing modes, but I started with the standard mode first. The time is listed as 1 hour, which is the washing time. The drying time after that seems to vary depending on the environment. When I first used it, I was confused because the dishwasher made a noise for almost 3 minutes until the 1 hour timer went down to 57 minutes, but there was no movement inside the glass. I thought I had installed it wrong, so I looked around for a while and it seems that the first 2-3 minutes are when the water in the water tank is sucked into the main unit, so it's only a sound. The same thing happens when I drain the water that was being washed and then supply new water. - The initial water sucking sound seems to be the loudest, and there's almost no noise during the wash. The water sucking sound seems quieter than that of a washing machine. When the door is closed, the sound isn't really audible inside the room. - After the 1-hour washing cycle is over, the door automatically opens to release heat and moisture, then closes and the fan runs, repeating this process to dry. Since steam and heat are released when the door is opened, you should always keep the area around it clean. <Washing Results, Pros and Cons>. - I haven't used it many times yet, but there were some white spots left after drying. Are they water marks? Not detergent residue? Other than that, it seems to have washed very well. I always wash the dishes with slightly warm water, but the weather has been so hot and humid lately that doing dishes in the kitchen has become a real burden. I'm satisfied that this mini dishwasher has helped ease that burden to some extent! - It cleans the spoons and chopsticks well, but I feel like they shouldn't overlap, so I have to place them one by one, even the chopsticks, which feels a bit cumbersome. I want to put it upright in the cutlery holder, but since it's a mini dishwasher, I need to find a cutlery holder that fits in the tray compartment and where the chopsticks won't fall out, which means less space, so I'm a little worried~. - It seems to have the most space on the second floor among mini dishwashers. It's long enough to put cooking utensils other than cutlery, which is nice. <Special detergent, all-in-one tablet>. - It says it's apple mint scented, but honestly, I'm not sure about the scent~ But it's convenient because it's tailored to the size of the Minix dishwasher and the amount of water it uses. After filling the dishwasher, your hands will be wet, and since dishwasher detergent dissolves well in water, you need to dry your hands thoroughly before using the detergent. I'd love to wash everything, including dishes and cooking utensils, but space constraints mean I'm only going to use dishes and cutlery. ] || ---------------- || I live alone. I'd love to use a dishwasher, but my kitchen is so small that I've been debating for quite some time. I'd love to wash everything, even dishes and utensils, but space constraints mean I'd rather just use dishes and cutlery. After browsing a few brands of mini dishwashers, I finally bought one! ^^ I chose the Minix because of its compact water supply system, its visible interior, the automatic door-opening feature after washing, and its design. :) <Packaging & Delivery>. The dishwasher and the complimentary detergent were shipped separately, but they arrived together. The box itself wasn't as heavy as I thought! The box itself had a string attached, but it wasn't just there for easy lifting. The packaging was thoughtful: cutting the string allowed the box lid to open, making it easy to remove the dishwasher. The inside of the box was meticulously secured, ensuring no damage during shipping. <Installation>. - Before installation, I opened the water tank at the bottom, and it was easy to open if I wanted to clean it during use. - The product itself wasn't as heavy as I thought, so I had no trouble lifting it by myself. However, when I placed the product on the water tank and tried to connect the drain/water supply, the narrow space made it difficult to connect the drain/water supply pipes on the back of the product. I think it would be easier to connect the drain/water supply pipes to the back of the product first, and then rotate the product to install it! - There's a black cardboard(?) inside the product that holds the tray and other items in place, but at first, it wouldn't come off. I struggled for a while, moving the tray and tilting the cardboard. If you look closely at the picture, the cardboard got caught on the wings at the top of the dishwasher when they were horizontal. If you place the top wings vertically so that the wings can pass through the holes in the cardboard, it will come off easily! <Washing and drying>. - After installation, use is very simple. First, turn on the power, open the drip tray at the front of the water tank, and fill it with water. Thanks to the protrusions inside the drip tray, I was amazed that even when I turned on the water, not a single drop splashed out! However, sink faucets usually use both a single-stream mode and a shower mode. In shower mode, water would splash. When I turn it on in single-stream mode, even if I turn on the sink water really hard, it doesn't splash at all. - There are several washing modes, but I started with the standard mode first. The time is listed as 1 hour, which is the washing time. The drying time after that seems to vary depending on the environment. When I first used it, I was confused because the dishwasher made a noise for almost 3 minutes until the 1 hour timer went down to 57 minutes, but there was no movement inside the glass. I thought I had installed it wrong, so I looked around for a while and it seems that the first 2-3 minutes are when the water in the water tank is sucked into the main unit, so it's only a sound. The same thing happens when I drain the water that was being washed and then supply new water. - The initial water sucking sound seems to be the loudest, and there's almost no noise during the wash. The water sucking sound seems quieter than that of a washing machine. When the door is closed, the sound isn't really audible inside the room. - After the 1-hour washing cycle is over, the door automatically opens to release heat and moisture, then closes and the fan runs, repeating this process to dry. Since steam and heat are released when the door is opened, you should always keep the area around it clean. <Washing Results, Pros and Cons>. - I haven't used it many times yet, but there were some white spots left after drying. Are they water marks? Not detergent residue? Other than that, it seems to have washed very well. I always wash the dishes with slightly warm water, but the weather has been so hot and humid lately that doing dishes in the kitchen has become a real burden. I'm satisfied that this mini dishwasher has helped ease that burden to some extent! - It cleans the spoons and chopsticks well, but I feel like they shouldn't overlap, so I have to place them one by one, even the chopsticks, which feels a bit cumbersome. I want to put it upright in the cutlery holder, but since it's a mini dishwasher, I need to find a cutlery holder that fits in the tray compartment and where the chopsticks won't fall out, which means less space, so I'm a little worried~. - It seems to have the most space on the second floor among mini dishwashers. It's long enough to put cooking utensils other than cutlery, which is nice. <Special detergent, all-in-one tablet>. - It says it's apple mint scented, but honestly, I'm not sure about the scent~ But it's convenient because it's tailored to the size of the Minix dishwasher and the amount of water it uses. After filling the dishwasher, your hands will be wet, and since dishwasher detergent dissolves well in water, you need to dry your hands thoroughly before using the detergent. I'd love to wash everything, including dishes and cooking utensils, but space constraints mean I'm only going to use dishes and cutlery. ] || ---------------- || I live alone. I'd love to use a dishwasher, but my kitchen is so small that I've been debating for quite some time. I'd love to wash everything, even dishes and utensils, but space constraints mean I'd rather just use dishes and cutlery. After browsing a few brands of mini dishwashers, I finally bought one! ^^ I chose the Minix because of its compact water supply system, its visible interior, the automatic door-opening feature after washing, and its design. :) <Packaging & Delivery>. The dishwasher and the complimentary detergent were shipped separately, but they arrived together. The box itself wasn't as heavy as I thought! The box itself had a string attached, but it wasn't just there for easy lifting. The packaging was thoughtful: cutting the string allowed the box lid to open, making it easy to remove the dishwasher. The inside of the box was meticulously secured, ensuring no damage during shipping. <Installation>. - Before installation, I opened the water tank at the bottom, and it was easy to open if I wanted to clean it during use. - The product itself wasn't as heavy as I thought, so I had no trouble lifting it by myself. However, when I placed the product on the water tank and tried to connect the drain/water supply, the narrow space made it difficult to connect the drain/water supply pipes on the back of the product. I think it would be easier to connect the drain/water supply pipes to the back of the product first, and then rotate the product to install it! - There's a black cardboard(?) inside the product that holds the tray and other items in place, but at first, it wouldn't come off. I struggled for a while, moving the tray and tilting the cardboard. If you look closely at the picture, the cardboard got caught on the wings at the top of the dishwasher when they were horizontal. If you place the top wings vertically so that the wings can pass through the holes in the cardboard, it will come off easily! <Washing and drying>. - After installation, use is very simple. First, turn on the power, open the drip tray at the front of the water tank, and fill it with water. Thanks to the protrusions inside the drip tray, I was amazed that even when I turned on the water, not a single drop splashed out! However, sink faucets usually use both a single-stream mode and a shower mode. In shower mode, water would splash. When I turn it on in single-stream mode, even if I turn on the sink water really hard, it doesn't splash at all. - There are several washing modes, but I started with the standard mode first. The time is listed as 1 hour, which is the washing time. The drying time after that seems to vary depending on the environment. When I first used it, I was confused because the dishwasher made a noise for almost 3 minutes until the 1 hour timer went down to 57 minutes, but there was no movement inside the glass. I thought I had installed it wrong, so I looked around for a while and it seems that the first 2-3 minutes are when the water in the water tank is sucked into the main unit, so it's only a sound. The same thing happens when I drain the water that was being washed and then supply new water. - The initial water sucking sound seems to be the loudest, and there's almost no noise during the wash. The water sucking sound seems quieter than that of a washing machine. When the door is closed, the sound isn't really audible inside the room. - After the 1-hour washing cycle is over, the door automatically opens to release heat and moisture, then closes and the fan runs, repeating this process to dry. Since steam and heat are released when the door is opened, you should always keep the area around it clean. <Washing Results, Pros and Cons>. - I haven't used it many times yet, but there were some white spots left after drying. Are they water marks? Not detergent residue? Other than that, it seems to have washed very well. I always wash the dishes with slightly warm water, but the weather has been so hot and humid lately that doing dishes in the kitchen has become a real burden. I'm satisfied that this mini dishwasher has helped ease that burden to some extent! - It cleans the spoons and chopsticks well, but I feel like they shouldn't overlap, so I have to place them one by one, even the chopsticks, which feels a bit cumbersome. I want to put it upright in the cutlery holder, but since it's a mini dishwasher, I need to find a cutlery holder that fits in the tray compartment and where the chopsticks won't fall out, which means less space, so I'm a little worried~. - It seems to have the most space on the second floor among mini dishwashers. It's long enough to put cooking utensils other than cutlery, which is nice. <Special detergent, all-in-one tablet>. - It says it's apple mint scented, but honestly, I'm not sure about the scent~ But it's convenient because it's tailored to the size of the Minix dishwasher and the amount of water it uses. After filling the dishwasher, your hands will be wet, and since dishwasher detergent dissolves well in water, you need to dry your hands thoroughly before using the detergent. I'd love to wash everything, including dishes and cooking utensils, but space constraints mean I'm only going to use dishes and cutlery. ] || ---------------- || I live alone. I'd love to use a dishwasher, but my kitchen is so small that I've been debating for quite some time. I'd love to wash everything, even dishes and utensils, but space constraints mean I'd rather just use dishes and cutlery. After browsing a few brands of mini dishwashers, I finally bought one! ^^ I chose the Minix because of its compact water supply system, its visible interior, the automatic door-opening feature after washing, and its design. :) <Packaging & Delivery>. The dishwasher and the complimentary detergent were shipped separately, but they arrived together. The box itself wasn't as heavy as I thought! The box itself had a string attached, but it wasn't just there for easy lifting. The packaging was thoughtful: cutting the string allowed the box lid to open, making it easy to remove the dishwasher. The inside of the box was meticulously secured, ensuring no damage during shipping. <Installation>. - Before installation, I opened the water tank at the bottom, and it was easy to open if I wanted to clean it during use. - The product itself wasn't as heavy as I thought, so I had no trouble lifting it by myself. However, when I placed the product on the water tank and tried to connect the drain/water supply, the narrow space made it difficult to connect the drain/water supply pipes on the back of the product. I think it would be easier to connect the drain/water supply pipes to the back of the product first, and then rotate the product to install it! - There's a black cardboard(?) inside the product that holds the tray and other items in place, but at first, it wouldn't come off. I struggled for a while, moving the tray and tilting the cardboard. If you look closely at the picture, the cardboard got caught on the wings at the top of the dishwasher when they were horizontal. If you place the top wings vertically so that the wings can pass through the holes in the cardboard, it will come off easily! <Washing and drying>. - After installation, use is very simple. First, turn on the power, open the drip tray at the front of the water tank, and fill it with water. Thanks to the protrusions inside the drip tray, I was amazed that even when I turned on the water, not a single drop splashed out! However, sink faucets usually use both a single-stream mode and a shower mode. In shower mode, water would splash. When I turn it on in single-stream mode, even if I turn on the sink water really hard, it doesn't splash at all. - There are several washing modes, but I started with the standard mode first. The time is listed as 1 hour, which is the washing time. The drying time after that seems to vary depending on the environment. When I first used it, I was confused because the dishwasher made a noise for almost 3 minutes until the 1 hour timer went down to 57 minutes, but there was no movement inside the glass. I thought I had installed it wrong, so I looked around for a while and it seems that the first 2-3 minutes are when the water in the water tank is sucked into the main unit, so it's only a sound. The same thing happens when I drain the water that was being washed and then supply new water. - The initial water sucking sound seems to be the loudest, and there's almost no noise during the wash. The water sucking sound seems quieter than that of a washing machine. When the door is closed, the sound isn't really audible inside the room. - After the 1-hour washing cycle is over, the door automatically opens to release heat and moisture, then closes and the fan runs, repeating this process to dry. Since steam and heat are released when the door is opened, you should always keep the area around it clean. <Washing Results, Pros and Cons>. - I haven't used it many times yet, but there were some white spots left after drying. Are they water marks? Not detergent residue? Other than that, it seems to have washed very well. I always wash the dishes with slightly warm water, but the weather has been so hot and humid lately that doing dishes in the kitchen has become a real burden. I'm satisfied that this mini dishwasher has helped ease that burden to some extent! - It cleans the spoons and chopsticks well, but I feel like they shouldn't overlap, so I have to place them one by one, even the chopsticks, which feels a bit cumbersome. I want to put it upright in the cutlery holder, but since it's a mini dishwasher, I need to find a cutlery holder that fits in the tray compartment and where the chopsticks won't fall out, which means less space, so I'm a little worried~. - It seems to have the most space on the second floor among mini dishwashers. It's long enough to put cooking utensils other than cutlery, which is nice. <Special detergent, all-in-one tablet>. - It says it's apple mint scented, but honestly, I'm not sure about the scent~ But it's convenient because it's tailored to the size of the Minix dishwasher and the amount of water it uses. After filling the dishwasher, your hands will be wet, and since dishwasher detergent dissolves well in water, you need to dry your hands thoroughly before using the detergent. I'd love to wash everything, including dishes and cooking utensils, but space constraints mean I'm only going to use dishes and cutlery. ] || ---------------- || I live alone. I'd love to use a dishwasher, but my kitchen is so small that I've been debating for quite some time. I'd love to wash everything, even dishes and utensils, but space constraints mean I'd rather just use dishes and cutlery. After browsing a few brands of mini dishwashers, I finally bought one! ^^ I chose the Minix because of its compact water supply system, its visible interior, the automatic door-opening feature after washing, and its design. :) <Packaging & Delivery>. The dishwasher and the complimentary detergent were shipped separately, but they arrived together. The box itself wasn't as heavy as I thought! The box itself had a string attached, but it wasn't just there for easy lifting. The packaging was thoughtful: cutting the string allowed the box lid to open, making it easy to remove the dishwasher. The inside of the box was meticulously secured, ensuring no damage during shipping. <Installation>. - Before installation, I opened the water tank at the bottom, and it was easy to open if I wanted to clean it during use. - The product itself wasn't as heavy as I thought, so I had no trouble lifting it by myself. However, when I placed the product on the water tank and tried to connect the drain/water supply, the narrow space made it difficult to connect the drain/water supply pipes on the back of the product. I think it would be easier to connect the drain/water supply pipes to the back of the product first, and then rotate the product to install it! - There's a black cardboard(?) inside the product that holds the tray and other items in place, but at first, it wouldn't come off. I struggled for a while, moving the tray and tilting the cardboard. If you look closely at the picture, the cardboard got caught on the wings at the top of the dishwasher when they were horizontal. If you place the top wings vertically so that the wings can pass through the holes in the cardboard, it will come off easily! <Washing and drying>. - After installation, use is very simple. First, turn on the power, open the drip tray at the front of the water tank, and fill it with water. Thanks to the protrusions inside the drip tray, I was amazed that even when I turned on the water, not a single drop splashed out! However, sink faucets usually use both a single-stream mode and a shower mode. In shower mode, water would splash. When I turn it on in single-stream mode, even if I turn on the sink water really hard, it doesn't splash at all. - There are several washing modes, but I started with the standard mode first. The time is listed as 1 hour, which is the washing time. The drying time after that seems to vary depending on the environment. When I first used it, I was confused because the dishwasher made a noise for almost 3 minutes until the 1 hour timer went down to 57 minutes, but there was no movement inside the glass. I thought I had installed it wrong, so I looked around for a while and it seems that the first 2-3 minutes are when the water in the water tank is sucked into the main unit, so it's only a sound. The same thing happens when I drain the water that was being washed and then supply new water. - The initial water sucking sound seems to be the loudest, and there's almost no noise during the wash. The water sucking sound seems quieter than that of a washing machine. When the door is closed, the sound isn't really audible inside the room. - After the 1-hour washing cycle is over, the door automatically opens to release heat and moisture, then closes and the fan runs, repeating this process to dry. Since steam and heat are released when the door is opened, you should always keep the area around it clean. <Washing Results, Pros and Cons>. - I haven't used it many times yet, but there were some white spots left after drying. Are they water marks? Not detergent residue? Other than that, it seems to have washed very well. I always wash the dishes with slightly warm water, but the weather has been so hot and humid lately that doing dishes in the kitchen has become a real burden. I'm satisfied that this mini dishwasher has helped ease that burden to some extent! - It cleans the spoons and chopsticks well, but I feel like they shouldn't overlap, so I have to place them one by one, even the chopsticks, which feels a bit cumbersome. I want to put it upright in the cutlery holder, but since it's a mini dishwasher, I need to find a cutlery holder that fits in the tray compartment and where the chopsticks won't fall out, which means less space, so I'm a little worried~. - It seems to have the most space on the second floor among mini dishwashers. It's long enough to put cooking utensils other than cutlery, which is nice. <Special detergent, all-in-one tablet>. - It says it's apple mint scented, but honestly, I'm not sure about the scent~ But it's convenient because it's tailored to the size of the Minix dishwasher and the amount of water it uses. After filling the dishwasher, your hands will be wet, and since dishwasher detergent dissolves well in water, you need to dry your hands thoroughly before using the detergent. I'd love to wash everything, including dishes and cooking utensils, but space constraints mean I'm only going to use dishes and cutlery. ] || ---------------- || I live alone. I'd love to use a dishwasher, but my kitchen is so small that I've been debating for quite some time. I'd love to wash everything, even dishes and utensils, but space constraints mean I'd rather just use dishes and cutlery. After browsing a few brands of mini dishwashers, I finally bought one! ^^ I chose the Minix because of its compact water supply system, its visible interior, the automatic door-opening feature after washing, and its design. :) <Packaging & Delivery>. The dishwasher and the complimentary detergent were shipped separately, but they arrived together. The box itself wasn't as heavy as I thought! The box itself had a string attached, but it wasn't just there for easy lifting. The packaging was thoughtful: cutting the string allowed the box lid to open, making it easy to remove the dishwasher. The inside of the box was meticulously secured, ensuring no damage during shipping. <Installation>. - Before installation, I opened the water tank at the bottom, and it was easy to open if I wanted to clean it during use. - The product itself wasn't as heavy as I thought, so I had no trouble lifting it by myself. However, when I placed the product on the water tank and tried to connect the drain/water supply, the narrow space made it difficult to connect the drain/water supply pipes on the back of the product. I think it would be easier to connect the drain/water supply pipes to the back of the product first, and then rotate the product to install it! - There's a black cardboard(?) inside the product that holds the tray and other items in place, but at first, it wouldn't come off. I struggled for a while, moving the tray and tilting the cardboard. If you look closely at the picture, the cardboard got caught on the wings at the top of the dishwasher when they were horizontal. If you place the top wings vertically so that the wings can pass through the holes in the cardboard, it will come off easily! <Washing and drying>. - After installation, use is very simple. First, turn on the power, open the drip tray at the front of the water tank, and fill it with water. Thanks to the protrusions inside the drip tray, I was amazed that even when I turned on the water, not a single drop splashed out! However, sink faucets usually use both a single-stream mode and a shower mode. In shower mode, water would splash. When I turn it on in single-stream mode, even if I turn on the sink water really hard, it doesn't splash at all. - There are several washing modes, but I started with the standard mode first. The time is listed as 1 hour, which is the washing time. The drying time after that seems to vary depending on the environment. When I first used it, I was confused because the dishwasher made a noise for almost 3 minutes until the 1 hour timer went down to 57 minutes, but there was no movement inside the glass. I thought I had installed it wrong, so I looked around for a while and it seems that the first 2-3 minutes are when the water in the water tank is sucked into the main unit, so it's only a sound. The same thing happens when I drain the water that was being washed and then supply new water. - The initial water sucking sound seems to be the loudest, and there's almost no noise during the wash. The water sucking sound seems quieter than that of a washing machine. When the door is closed, the sound isn't really audible inside the room. - After the 1-hour washing cycle is over, the door automatically opens to release heat and moisture, then closes and the fan runs, repeating this process to dry. Since steam and heat are released when the door is opened, you should always keep the area around it clean. <Washing Results, Pros and Cons>. - I haven't used it many times yet, but there were some white spots left after drying. Are they water marks? Not detergent residue? Other than that, it seems to have washed very well. I always wash the dishes with slightly warm water, but the weather has been so hot and humid lately that doing dishes in the kitchen has become a real burden. I'm satisfied that this mini dishwasher has helped ease that burden to some extent! - It cleans the spoons and chopsticks well, but I feel like they shouldn't overlap, so I have to place them one by one, even the chopsticks, which feels a bit cumbersome. I want to put it upright in the cutlery holder, but since it's a mini dishwasher, I need to find a cutlery holder that fits in the tray compartment and where the chopsticks won't fall out, which means less space, so I'm a little worried~. - It seems to have the most space on the second floor among mini dishwashers. It's long enough to put cooking utensils other than cutlery, which is nice. <Special detergent, all-in-one tablet>. - It says it's apple mint scented, but honestly, I'm not sure about the scent~ But it's convenient because it's tailored to the size of the Minix dishwasher and the amount of water it uses. After filling the dishwasher, your hands will be wet, and since dishwasher detergent dissolves well in water, you need to dry your hands thoroughly before using the detergent. I'd love to wash everything, including dishes and cooking utensils, but space constraints mean I'm only going to use dishes and cutlery. ] || ---------------- || I live alone. I'd love to use a dishwasher, but my kitchen is so small that I've been debating for quite some time. I'd love to wash everything, even dishes and utensils, but space constraints mean I'd rather just use dishes and cutlery. After browsing a few brands of mini dishwashers, I finally bought one! ^^ I chose the Minix because of its compact water supply system, its visible interior, the automatic door-opening feature after washing, and its design. :) <Packaging & Delivery>. The dishwasher and the complimentary detergent were shipped separately, but they arrived together. The box itself wasn't as heavy as I thought! The box itself had a string attached, but it wasn't just there for easy lifting. The packaging was thoughtful: cutting the string allowed the box lid to open, making it easy to remove the dishwasher. The inside of the box was meticulously secured, ensuring no damage during shipping. <Installation>. - Before installation, I opened the water tank at the bottom, and it was easy to open if I wanted to clean it during use. - The product itself wasn't as heavy as I thought, so I had no trouble lifting it by myself. However, when I placed the product on the water tank and tried to connect the drain/water supply, the narrow space made it difficult to connect the drain/water supply pipes on the back of the product. I think it would be easier to connect the drain/water supply pipes to the back of the product first, and then rotate the product to install it! - There's a black cardboard(?) inside the product that holds the tray and other items in place, but at first, it wouldn't come off. I struggled for a while, moving the tray and tilting the cardboard. If you look closely at the picture, the cardboard got caught on the wings at the top of the dishwasher when they were horizontal. If you place the top wings vertically so that the wings can pass through the holes in the cardboard, it will come off easily! <Washing and drying>. - After installation, use is very simple. First, turn on the power, open the drip tray at the front of the water tank, and fill it with water. Thanks to the protrusions inside the drip tray, I was amazed that even when I turned on the water, not a single drop splashed out! However, sink faucets usually use both a single-stream mode and a shower mode. In shower mode, water would splash. When I turn it on in single-stream mode, even if I turn on the sink water really hard, it doesn't splash at all. - There are several washing modes, but I started with the standard mode first. The time is listed as 1 hour, which is the washing time. The drying time after that seems to vary depending on the environment. When I first used it, I was confused because the dishwasher made a noise for almost 3 minutes until the 1 hour timer went down to 57 minutes, but there was no movement inside the glass. I thought I had installed it wrong, so I looked around for a while and it seems that the first 2-3 minutes are when the water in the water tank is sucked into the main unit, so it's only a sound. The same thing happens when I drain the water that was being washed and then supply new water. - The initial water sucking sound seems to be the loudest, and there's almost no noise during the wash. The water sucking sound seems quieter than that of a washing machine. When the door is closed, the sound isn't really audible inside the room. - After the 1-hour washing cycle is over, the door automatically opens to release heat and moisture, then closes and the fan runs, repeating this process to dry. Since steam and heat are released when the door is opened, you should always keep the area around it clean. <Washing Results, Pros and Cons>. - I haven't used it many times yet, but there were some white spots left after drying. Are they water marks? Not detergent residue? Other than that, it seems to have washed very well. I always wash the dishes with slightly warm water, but the weather has been so hot and humid lately that doing dishes in the kitchen has become a real burden. I'm satisfied that this mini dishwasher has helped ease that burden to some extent! - It cleans the spoons and chopsticks well, but I feel like they shouldn't overlap, so I have to place them one by one, even the chopsticks, which feels a bit cumbersome. I want to put it upright in the cutlery holder, but since it's a mini dishwasher, I need to find a cutlery holder that fits in the tray compartment and where the chopsticks won't fall out, which means less space, so I'm a little worried~. - It seems to have the most space on the second floor among mini dishwashers. It's long enough to put cooking utensils other than cutlery, which is nice. <Special detergent, all-in-one tablet>. - It says it's apple mint scented, but honestly, I'm not sure about the scent~ But it's convenient because it's tailored to the size of the Minix dishwasher and the amount of water it uses. After filling the dishwasher, your hands will be wet, and since dishwasher detergent dissolves well in water, you need to dry your hands thoroughly before using the detergent. I'd love to wash everything, including dishes and cooking utensils, but space constraints mean I'm only going to use dishes and cutlery. ] || ---------------- || I live alone. I'd love to use a dishwasher, but my kitchen is so small that I've been debating for quite some time. I'd love to wash everything, even dishes and utensils, but space constraints mean I'd rather just use dishes and cutlery. After browsing a few brands of mini dishwashers, I finally bought one! ^^ I chose the Minix because of its compact water supply system, its visible interior, the automatic door-opening feature after washing, and its design. :) <Packaging & Delivery>. The dishwasher and the complimentary detergent were shipped separately, but they arrived together. The box itself wasn't as heavy as I thought! The box itself had a string attached, but it wasn't just there for easy lifting. The packaging was thoughtful: cutting the string allowed the box lid to open, making it easy to remove the dishwasher. The inside of the box was meticulously secured, ensuring no damage during shipping. <Installation>. - Before installation, I opened the water tank at the bottom, and it was easy to open if I wanted to clean it during use. - The product itself wasn't as heavy as I thought, so I had no trouble lifting it by myself. However, when I placed the product on the water tank and tried to connect the drain/water supply, the narrow space made it difficult to connect the drain/water supply pipes on the back of the product. I think it would be easier to connect the drain/water supply pipes to the back of the product first, and then rotate the product to install it! - There's a black cardboard(?) inside the product that holds the tray and other items in place, but at first, it wouldn't come off. I struggled for a while, moving the tray and tilting the cardboard. If you look closely at the picture, the cardboard got caught on the wings at the top of the dishwasher when they were horizontal. If you place the top wings vertically so that the wings can pass through the holes in the cardboard, it will come off easily! <Washing and drying>. - After installation, use is very simple. First, turn on the power, open the drip tray at the front of the water tank, and fill it with water. Thanks to the protrusions inside the drip tray, I was amazed that even when I turned on the water, not a single drop splashed out! However, sink faucets usually use both a single-stream mode and a shower mode. In shower mode, water would splash. When I turn it on in single-stream mode, even if I turn on the sink water really hard, it doesn't splash at all. - There are several washing modes, but I started with the standard mode first. The time is listed as 1 hour, which is the washing time. The drying time after that seems to vary depending on the environment. When I first used it, I was confused because the dishwasher made a noise for almost 3 minutes until the 1 hour timer went down to 57 minutes, but there was no movement inside the glass. I thought I had installed it wrong, so I looked around for a while and it seems that the first 2-3 minutes are when the water in the water tank is sucked into the main unit, so it's only a sound. The same thing happens when I drain the water that was being washed and then supply new water. - The initial water sucking sound seems to be the loudest, and there's almost no noise during the wash. The water sucking sound seems quieter than that of a washing machine. When the door is closed, the sound isn't really audible inside the room. - After the 1-hour washing cycle is over, the door automatically opens to release heat and moisture, then closes and the fan runs, repeating this process to dry. Since steam and heat are released when the door is opened, you should always keep the area around it clean. <Washing Results, Pros and Cons>. - I haven't used it many times yet, but there were some white spots left after drying. Are they water marks? Not detergent residue? Other than that, it seems to have washed very well. I always wash the dishes with slightly warm water, but the weather has been so hot and humid lately that doing dishes in the kitchen has become a real burden. I'm satisfied that this mini dishwasher has helped ease that burden to some extent! - It cleans the spoons and chopsticks well, but I feel like they shouldn't overlap, so I have to place them one by one, even the chopsticks, which feels a bit cumbersome. I want to put it upright in the cutlery holder, but since it's a mini dishwasher, I need to find a cutlery holder that fits in the tray compartment and where the chopsticks won't fall out, which means less space, so I'm a little worried~. - It seems to have the most space on the second floor among mini dishwashers. It's long enough to put cooking utensils other than cutlery, which is nice. <Special detergent, all-in-one tablet>. - It says it's apple mint scented, but honestly, I'm not sure about the scent~ But it's convenient because it's tailored to the size of the Minix dishwasher and the amount of water it uses. After filling the dishwasher, your hands will be wet, and since dishwasher detergent dissolves well in water, you need to dry your hands thoroughly before using the detergent. 그 외에는 뽀득하게 잘 씻긴것 같아요. 설거지는 항상 어느정도 따뜻한 물로 해야하는데 요즘 날씨가 하도 덥고 습해서 주방에서 설거지하기가 정말 부담스러운데, 미니 식세기이지만 어느정도 그 부담을 덜 수 있어서 만족스럽습니다!- 2층에 놓은 수저도 잘 닦이지만, 수저가 겹치면 안될 것 같아서 젓가락까지 하나하나 칸에 맞게 놓아야하는게 좀 번거롭게 느껴집니다. 수저통에 와르르 꽂아서 세워넣고 싶은데, 미니 식세기이다보니 트레이 칸에 맞으면서도 젓가락이 빠지지 않을 수저통을 구해야하고, 그만큼 공간이 줄어들게 되니 살짝 고민되는 부분입니다~- 미니 식세기 중에서 2층 공간이 가장 넓은것 같아요. 수저 외에 조리도구를 놓을 수 있는 길이여서 좋습니다.<전용세제, 올인원 타블렛>- 애플민트향이라고 되어있는데, 솔직히 향은 잘 모르겠어요~ 그래도 미닉스 식세기의 사이즈와 사용하는 물 용량에 맞춤이라고 하여 편리합니다. 식세기에 내용물을 채우고 나면 손에 물기가 있는데, 식세기 세제가 물에 잘 녹기 때문에 손에 물기를 잘 말리고 세제를 이용해야합니다. 세제전용으로 미니 집게를 하나 두고 써도 좋을것 같아요~<기타>- 다른 브랜드의 바스켓 방식이나 상부 급수방식이 아니라서 식세기 옆 공간, 윗공간이 반드시 필요하지는 않지만, 앞에서 언급했듯 건조시 열기와 수증기가 뿜어져 나오기 때문에 충분한 공간을 확보하는게 좋을것 같습니다. 본체 위, 문이 열리는 근처에 뭔가 올려두지 마세요~- 시간 예약도 가능해서, 밤늦게 귀가한 날에도 다음날 아침으로 예약해놓으면 좋을 것 같아요.- 그릇과 수저를 미닉스 식세기에 넣어 돌리는 동안 몇 개 남은 큰 설거지를 하는데, 이 정도만 해도 설거지 부담이 확 줄어들어서 좋아요!

Sentence (English): As a dual-income couple, we've been agonizing over dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Perfect for a family of 1-2 people! ] || ---------------- || As a dual-income couple, we've been agonizing over dishwashers. After work, we enjoy a delicious dinner, then the pile of dishes can be stressful. Since we don't have a built-in dishwasher in our cabinets, we agonized over sizes for 3 and 6 people. *In conclusion, we decided on a 3-person dishwasher. While we do cook at least one meal at home, we're not full-time housewives, so we don't cook side dishes every day. Sometimes, there's only a little bit of dishwashing. I've noticed more people than I thought who buy dishwashers larger than 12 people but don't use them regularly because they're so big. That's why I thought the Minix was the perfect size for us, a family of two, and after using it, I'm even more convinced it was a good choice. *And as you can see, the design is beautiful. Personally, I think it's the prettiest compact dishwasher currently on the market. *It's not completely quiet. It's a bit noisy when it sucks up water, but other than that, it seems okay. Since it's a small house, you can tell that something is running, but it's not extremely loud. If you're watching TV or using your phone in a space other than the kitchen, it's so noisy that you'll forget about it. *I use liquid detergent specifically for daily use*** dishwashers, not solid detergent. I pour about 5ml on the floor and run it. It washes the dishes cleanly without leaving any white marks! I'm happy that I don't have to stress about having to do the dishes again when I get home from work. Buy your time for around 300,000 won.

I love having that rack available for spatulas and especially plastic lids and very small bowls that usually don’t fit in traditional racks very well, or get Blasted and turned upside down by the water jets. I’ve seen some people complain about the Third rack interfering with the bottle jets as many bottles won’t clear if the third rack is in. So the first thing I did was I just removed that Third rack! Simple enough to do. Until I noticed that that upper rack has three adjustable heights!  You simply pull out the rack and make it lower! That gives you plenty of options for plenty of different size bottles to use the bottle jet function. I found even on its lowest setting my biggest dinner plates had no problem clearing. Now, a big stock pot would not clear with it on its lowest function,  But when I’m ready to do that pot all I need to do is raise the rack again. It’s not like it’s that hard. The next function I loved about this machine is the one hour wash! A regular wash takes a couple of hours, a heavy wash can take over three hours. If you use a good dishwasher soap, I use the great value powder from Walmart, it was tested and found to be Superior or equal to the higher price brands. I make sure that my sink water is already hot and that may take running it for a minute or so. If you have a water recirculator, it’s not necessary, but if you don’t get hot water to your dishwasher as soon as it starts,  You’ll be rinsing off your dishes with cooler water and your dishes won’t get as clean. That being said, that little indentation on top of the cup where your main detergent goes is for pre-wash. Your dishwasher loads water in cycles. The first cycle is your pre-wash and if you don’t put any detergent in there, you’ll not get as good a clean. I only use about a teaspoon of powder in that cup.  Also know if you just throw your dish soap in the dishwasher or leave your cup door open you’re only getting soap on that first cycle and the subsequent cycles won’t have any soap in them. Also making sure that your dishes don’t get as clean as they could. If I have a load that is especially grimy, I may add a little more. I like the way the water jets hit the silverware basket.  And I like that there are different openings for slots on top. Some of my silverware will fit in the thinner, slots others the thicker slots and I like having both options. I had never used these slots before because my previous dishwasher was just an open basket. But I find that the silverware gets so much cleaner this way.I found the filter on the bottom to be really easy to get to unlike my previous machine. And I only cleaned it out once a week unless I notice debris on the bottom of an exceptionally dirty load. In which case I’ll clean it out on the spot.I like all of the different dry cycles, including the dry boost, but I find that the dishes get so clean, that all I really need to do is open the door and pull out the top basket a bit, and I let it air dry.  The dishes come out spotless and I’ve saved a lot of money with decreased energy consumption.Overall, I am thrilled with this unit, and I got it at a time when it was on sale with additional discounts and I feel I couldn’t have gotten a better deal!

Sentence (English): We bought the machine approx 1 month ago and it by far exceeds the LG brand machine we had previously.
Comments (English): [ Whirlpool 3rd rack dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We bought the machine approx 1 month ago and it by far exceeds the LG brand machine we had previously. The third rack allows more flexibility in placing odd shaped kitchen tools and mugs.Our previous machine had problems cleaning anything on the third rack, but the Whirlpool does an excellent job. The wife tested the machine by not prerinsing any plates or pans and putting them thru t quick wash option. Everything came out spotless. We like the ease of operation. There is not a bunch of unnecessary settings to scroll thru and the washing and drying options are simple to cycle thru and select.Very quiet operation. Just a warning though , if you do run the machine thru a drying cycle do not place any plastic utensils or equipment in the bottom rack as the heater element gives off sufficient heat to warp some types of plastic. We found that with the stainless tub we don't really need to run a drying cycle with the heater element to dry the dishes properly. We just had to wait 15 to 20 minutes after the wash was finished to put away the dishes.

Sentence (English): (This review was collected as part of a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Whirlpool 3rd rack dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) We bought the machine approx 1 month ago and it by far exceeds the LG brand machine we had previously. The third rack allows more flexibility in placing odd shaped kitchen tools and mugs.Our previous machine had problems cleaning anything on the third rack, but the Whirlpool does an excellent job. The wife tested the machine by not prerinsing any plates or pans and putting them thru t quick wash option. Everything came out spotless. We like the ease of operation. There is not a bunch of unnecessary settings to scroll thru and the washing and drying options are simple to cycle thru and select.Very quiet operation. Just a warning though , if you do run the machine thru a drying cycle do not place any plastic utensils or equipment in the bottom rack as the heater element gives off sufficient heat to warp some types of plastic. We found that with the stainless tub we don't really need to run a drying cycle with the heater element to dry the dishes properly. We just had to wait 15 to 20 minutes after the wash was finished to put away the dishes.

The reply was that the detergent isn't harmful and that I could leave it open if the moisture was bothersome. Haha. Honestly, the detergent isn't harmful, but the moisture still clinging to the outside is a concern for mold, so I just unplug it at night and leave it open. (If I leave the cord on and open it, the LAN cable light stays on.) It's very inconvenient. I bought it because it's a Mutagong, but honestly, if that weren't the case, I think I'd buy something else. The design is pretty and I'm satisfied.

MINIX Dishwasher PRO 3-Person No-Installation Mini Dishwasher, Charcoal Gray, MNDW-100 (Charcoal Gray)! I thought about it for a few months, but after finishing my second job at a cafe, I was so tired that I thought I absolutely had to get out of the dishwashing hell at home, so I thought I had to buy it, so I decided to buy a dishwasher right away with the money I received from my summer vacation. After researching for a while, I found a dishwasher that met my needs and purchased it. My kitchen is small, and I can't afford to drill holes separately. I also work two jobs, so I can't hire someone to install it. So, I was looking for something I could install myself. Of course, I'd previously purchased a dishwasher that didn't require installation, so I decided against it and decided to just wash the dishes myself. But you never know; working part-time at a cafe made washing dishes a thing of the past, and the weather was incredibly hot, so I couldn't bring myself to do the dishes. So, I bought it right away. I remembered using a Minix dryer before and loved it, so I decided to buy it. I'd done a lot of research and measured the Minix products to see if they fit my kitchen, so I waited to see if the Coupang Experience Group would include a dishwasher, and they did have a pet line. ^^. So, even though it's a big expense for a single person living alone, I bought a dishwasher. When it arrived, the box was completely torn, which was really frustrating. I was considering having it resent, but I decided to give it a try and see if it was broken beforehand. When I first installed it, I didn't read the manual and just went with it, thinking, "This is just a piece of crap!" It got clogged, and I was reminded that people really need to read the manual. The bottom water tank is convenient, but the water splashes a lot when pouring into the narrow line, which is a bit of a drawback. I wish the water inlet was wider. The touchscreen sometimes didn't work, which was a bit disconcerting, but I'm using it now. I saw that the automatic door was supposed to open, but it seemed to have been closed for a few days, so I was a little puzzled. It opened and closed again, and it was amazing. I also liked that the LED indicator light indicates that it's open. I've been using it for almost a week now, and I love that I don't have to use my hands! For products that are heavily contaminated, it might need to be slightly soaked and pre-washed, but that's okay for me! I've definitely purchased the Minix Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, No-Installation Mini Dishwasher, Charcoal Gray, MNDW-100 (Charcoal Gray) again! This is my honest review, purchased with my own money. For products that are heavily contaminated, it might need to be slightly soaked and pre-washed, but that's okay for me! Sentence (English): [[My Money, Real Review]] This was my first time buying a dishwasher, and since it was a lot of money, I was hesitant, but it was a decision I didn't regret at all.
Comments (English): [[My Money, Real Review]] This was my first time buying a dishwasher, and since it was a lot of money, I was hesitant, but it was a decision I didn't regret at all. To summarize the advantages, 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all easy, so there was nothing to learn separately.) 2. It's spacious enough for 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying large appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person one. Even though we're a family of three, we end up with quite a lot of dishes when we cook, and it was more spacious than I thought. Definitely buy a 14-person one! ^0^ 3. Simple and pretty design. - I really like the timeless design and how it blends in naturally with my home interior without standing out. The color is also subtle and pretty, and first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher and think it's just a sink. The color is [Nature Beige], a soft and light pink that's not tacky, but rather a classy and pretty color with a bit of femininity. The color of my house's sink is ivory, which is close to white, so it goes well with it without any awkwardness^.^ 4. There's a sterilization and hot air mode, so you don't have to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other things cleanly without any water stains, so I really like that I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and the latest model. - Coupang seems to be cheaper than online prices, and since it's the latest model, the shortcomings of existing dishwashers are addressed and upgraded, which is nice. 6. You can file an insurance claim by paying an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - They say dishwashers break down more often than you think, so I like that you can get insurance benefits by paying an additional tens of thousands of won. I haven't really noticed any disadvantages while using it so far, so I don't have anything to write about. If there are any more later, I will edit and post them. ^^ In conclusion, this is my first purchase of a dishwasher, and I chose it after months of careful consideration. It is sturdy and practical, so I really recommend it. If there is anyone who is still having trouble choosing a dishwasher, don't waste any more time and definitely buy it~~^.^
Comments (Original): [[내돈 내산, 리얼 후기]]식기세척기 처음 구매이고 거금이라 고민 많이 했었는데 돈이 하나도 아깝지 않은 선택입니다.장점을 요약하자면,1.식기 초보자도 어렵지 않는 조작 방식.(설치 기사님이 알려주신대로도 해보고 여러 기능 사용해봤는데 다 쉬워서 따로 익힐게 없어요.)2.14인용이라 넉넉한 사이즈.-왜 주부님들이 가전제품은 무조건 큰거 사라고 하는지 알겠더라고요. 12인용 샀으면 후회할 뻔했어요. 3인가족인데도 요리하면 꽤 설거지 거리가 생기는데 생각보다 꽉 차더라고요. 무조건 14인용 사세요!!!^0^3.심플하고 예쁜 디자인.-딱히 유행을타지 않을 디자인에 집에 있는 인테리어와도 따로 놀지 않고 자연스럽게 어울려서 정말 마음에 듭니다. 컬러도 은은하니 예쁘고 처음 방문하여 보는 사람들은 식기세척기인 줄 모르고 그냥 싱크대인 줄 알아요. 컬러는 [네이처 베이지] 은은하고 연하게 핑크빛이 살짝 도는데 촌스럽지 않고 약간 여성미가 느껴지는 고급스럽게 예쁜 컬러예요. 우리집 싱크대 색상이 화이트에 가까운 아이보리인데 딱히 이질감 없이 잘 어울려요^.^4.살균, 열풍 모드가 있어서 식기에 때 물자국 걱정 없음.-동영상 보시면 아시겠지만 그릇이든 뭐든 딱히 물때 자국 없이 깔끔하게 건조시켜줘서 바로 수납장에 넣으면 되서 참 좋아요. 5.가격 대비 저렴하며 최신식 모델임.-쿠팡이 온라인 가격보다 더 저렴한 편 같고, 최신식 모델이라 기존 식기세척기의 단점은 보안하고 더 업그레이드 되서 좋습니다.6.구매시 몇 만원 추가 결제하면 보험 청구가 가능함.-식기 세척기는 생각보다 고장이 잘난다고 하던데 몇만원만 추가로 구매하면 보험혜택이 있어서 마음에 들었습니다. 단점은지금까지 사용하면서 딱히 못 느껴서 적을게 없네요..만약 후에 생겨나게 되면 추가로 수정해서 올리겠습니다^^결론적으로 식기세척기 첫 구매이고 심사숙고해서 몇 개월만에 픽한 제품인데, 튼튼하고 실용적이여서 정말 추천드립니다.아직도 식기세척기 선택에 고민중이신 분이 계신다면 더 이상 시간낭비 하지마시고,꼭 구매하시길 바래요~~^.^♡

Comments (English): [[My Money, Real Review]] This was my first time buying a dishwasher, and since it was a lot of money, I was hesitant, but it was a decision I didn't regret at all. To summarize the advantages, 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all easy, so there was nothing to learn separately.) 2. It's spacious enough for 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying large appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person one. Even though we're a family of three, we end up with quite a lot of dishes when we cook, and it was more spacious than I thought. Definitely buy a 14-person one! ^0^ 3. Simple and pretty design. - I really like the timeless design and how it blends in naturally with my home interior without standing out. The color is also subtle and pretty, and first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher and think it's just a sink. The color is [Nature Beige], a soft and light pink that's not tacky, but rather a classy and pretty color with a bit of femininity. The color of my house's sink is ivory, which is close to white, so it goes well with it without any awkwardness^.^ 4. There's a sterilization and hot air mode, so you don't have to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other things cleanly without any water stains, so I really like that I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and the latest model. - Coupang seems to be cheaper than online prices, and since it's the latest model, the shortcomings of existing dishwashers are addressed and upgraded, which is nice. 6. You can file an insurance claim by paying an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - They say dishwashers break down more often than you think, so I like that you can get insurance benefits by paying an additional tens of thousands of won. I haven't really noticed any disadvantages while using it so far, so I don't have anything to write about. If there are any more later, I will edit and post them. ^^ In conclusion, this is my first purchase of a dishwasher, and I chose it after months of careful consideration. It is sturdy and practical, so I really recommend it. If there is anyone who is still having trouble choosing a dishwasher, don't waste any more time and definitely buy it~~^.^

(I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all easy, so there was nothing to learn separately.) 2. It's spacious enough for 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying large appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person one. Even though we're a family of three, we end up with quite a lot of dishes when we cook, and it was more spacious than I thought. Definitely buy a 14-person one! ^0^ 3. Simple and pretty design. - I really like the timeless design and how it blends in naturally with my home interior without standing out. The color is also subtle and pretty, and first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher and think it's just a sink. The color is [Nature Beige], a soft and light pink that's not tacky, but rather a classy and pretty color with a bit of femininity. The color of my house's sink is ivory, which is close to white, so it goes well with it without any awkwardness^.^ 4. There's a sterilization and hot air mode, so you don't have to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other things cleanly without any water stains, so I really like that I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and the latest model. - Coupang seems to be cheaper than online prices, and since it's the latest model, the shortcomings of existing dishwashers are addressed and upgraded, which is nice. 6. You can file an insurance claim by paying an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - They say dishwashers break down more often than you think, so I like that you can get insurance benefits by paying an additional tens of thousands of won. I haven't really noticed any disadvantages while using it so far, so I don't have anything to write about. If there are any more later, I will edit and post them. ^^ In conclusion, this is my first purchase of a dishwasher, and I chose it after months of careful consideration. It is sturdy and practical, so I really recommend it. If there is anyone who is still having trouble choosing a dishwasher, don't waste any more time and definitely buy it~~^.^
Comments (Original): [[내돈 내산, 리얼 후기]]식기세척기 처음 구매이고 거금이라 고민 많이 했었는데 돈이 하나도 아깝지 않은 선택입니다.장점을 요약하자면,1.식기 초보자도 어렵지 않는 조작 방식.(설치 기사님이 알려주신대로도 해보고 여러 기능 사용해봤는데 다 쉬워서 따로 익힐게 없어요.)2.14인용이라 넉넉한 사이즈.-왜 주부님들이 가전제품은 무조건 큰거 사라고 하는지 알겠더라고요. 12인용 샀으면 후회할 뻔했어요. 3인가족인데도 요리하면 꽤 설거지 거리가 생기는데 생각보다 꽉 차더라고요. 무조건 14인용 사세요!!!^0^3.심플하고 예쁜 디자인.-딱히 유행을타지 않을 디자인에 집에 있는 인테리어와도 따로 놀지 않고 자연스럽게 어울려서 정말 마음에 듭니다. 컬러도 은은하니 예쁘고 처음 방문하여 보는 사람들은 식기세척기인 줄 모르고 그냥 싱크대인 줄 알아요. 컬러는 [네이처 베이지] 은은하고 연하게 핑크빛이 살짝 도는데 촌스럽지 않고 약간 여성미가 느껴지는 고급스럽게 예쁜 컬러예요. 우리집 싱크대 색상이 화이트에 가까운 아이보리인데 딱히 이질감 없이 잘 어울려요^.^4.살균, 열풍 모드가 있어서 식기에 때 물자국 걱정 없음.-동영상 보시면 아시겠지만 그릇이든 뭐든 딱히 물때 자국 없이 깔끔하게 건조시켜줘서 바로 수납장에 넣으면 되서 참 좋아요. 5.가격 대비 저렴하며 최신식 모델임.-쿠팡이 온라인 가격보다 더 저렴한 편 같고, 최신식 모델이라 기존 식기세척기의 단점은 보안하고 더 업그레이드 되서 좋습니다.6.구매시 몇 만원 추가 결제하면 보험 청구가 가능함.-식기 세척기는 생각보다 고장이 잘난다고 하던데 몇만원만 추가로 구매하면 보험혜택이 있어서 마음에 들었습니다. 단점은지금까지 사용하면서 딱히 못 느껴서 적을게 없네요..만약 후에 생겨나게 되면 추가로 수정해서 올리겠습니다^^결론적으로 식기세척기 첫 구매이고 심사숙고해서 몇 개월만에 픽한 제품인데, 튼튼하고 실용적이여서 정말 추천드립니다.아직도 식기세척기 선택에 고민중이신 분이 계신다면 더 이상 시간낭비 하지마시고,꼭 구매하시길 바래요~~^.^♡

Comments (English): [[My Money, Real Review]] This was my first time buying a dishwasher, and since it was a lot of money, I was hesitant, but it was a decision I didn't regret at all. To summarize the advantages, 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all easy, so there was nothing to learn separately.) 2. It's spacious enough for 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying large appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person one. Even though we're a family of three, we end up with quite a lot of dishes when we cook, and it was more spacious than I thought. Definitely buy a 14-person one! ^0^ 3. Simple and pretty design. - I really like the timeless design and how it blends in naturally with my home interior without standing out. The color is also subtle and pretty, and first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher and think it's just a sink. The color is [Nature Beige], a soft and light pink that's not tacky, but rather a classy and pretty color with a bit of femininity. The color of my house's sink is ivory, which is close to white, so it goes well with it without any awkwardness^.^ 4. There's a sterilization and hot air mode, so you don't have to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other things cleanly without any water stains, so I really like that I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and the latest model. - Coupang seems to be cheaper than online prices, and since it's the latest model, the shortcomings of existing dishwashers are addressed and upgraded, which is nice. 6. You can file an insurance claim by paying an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - They say dishwashers break down more often than you think, so I like that you can get insurance benefits by paying an additional tens of thousands of won. I haven't really noticed any disadvantages while using it so far, so I don't have anything to write about. If there are any more later, I will edit and post them. ^^ In conclusion, this is my first purchase of a dishwasher, and I chose it after months of careful consideration. It is sturdy and practical, so I really recommend it. If there is anyone who is still having trouble choosing a dishwasher, don't waste any more time and definitely buy it~~^.^

Comments (English): [[My Money, Real Review]] This was my first time buying a dishwasher, and since it was a lot of money, I was hesitant, but it was a decision I didn't regret at all. To summarize the advantages, 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all easy, so there was nothing to learn separately.) 2. It's spacious enough for 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying large appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person one. Even though we're a family of three, we end up with quite a lot of dishes when we cook, and it was more spacious than I thought. Definitely buy a 14-person one! ^0^ 3. Simple and pretty design. - I really like the timeless design and how it blends in naturally with my home interior without standing out. The color is also subtle and pretty, and first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher and think it's just a sink. The color is [Nature Beige], a soft and light pink that's not tacky, but rather a classy and pretty color with a bit of femininity. The color of my house's sink is ivory, which is close to white, so it goes well with it without any awkwardness^.^ 4. There's a sterilization and hot air mode, so you don't have to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other things cleanly without any water stains, so I really like that I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and the latest model. - Coupang seems to be cheaper than online prices, and since it's the latest model, the shortcomings of existing dishwashers are addressed and upgraded, which is nice. 6. You can file an insurance claim by paying an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - They say dishwashers break down more often than you think, so I like that you can get insurance benefits by paying an additional tens of thousands of won. I haven't really noticed any disadvantages while using it so far, so I don't have anything to write about. If there are any more later, I will edit and post them. ^^ In conclusion, this is my first purchase of a dishwasher, and I chose it after months of careful consideration. It is sturdy and practical, so I really recommend it. If there is anyone who is still having trouble choosing a dishwasher, don't waste any more time and definitely buy it~~^.^

To summarize the advantages, 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all easy, so there was nothing to learn separately.) 2. It's spacious enough for 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying large appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person one. Even though we're a family of three, we end up with quite a lot of dishes when we cook, and it was more spacious than I thought. Definitely buy a 14-person one! ^0^ 3. Simple and pretty design. - I really like the timeless design and how it blends in naturally with my home interior without standing out. The color is also subtle and pretty, and first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher and think it's just a sink. The color is [Nature Beige], a soft and light pink that's not tacky, but rather a classy and pretty color with a bit of femininity. The color of my house's sink is ivory, which is close to white, so it goes well with it without any awkwardness^.^ 4. There's a sterilization and hot air mode, so you don't have to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other things cleanly without any water stains, so I really like that I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and the latest model. - Coupang seems to be cheaper than online prices, and since it's the latest model, the shortcomings of existing dishwashers are addressed and upgraded, which is nice. 6. You can file an insurance claim by paying an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - They say dishwashers break down more often than you think, so I like that you can get insurance benefits by paying an additional tens of thousands of won. I haven't really noticed any disadvantages while using it so far, so I don't have anything to write about. If there are any more later, I will edit and post them. ^^ In conclusion, this is my first purchase of a dishwasher, and I chose it after months of careful consideration. It is sturdy and practical, so I really recommend it. If there is anyone who is still having trouble choosing a dishwasher, don't waste any more time and definitely buy it~~^.^
Comments (Original): [[내돈 내산, 리얼 후기]]식기세척기 처음 구매이고 거금이라 고민 많이 했었는데 돈이 하나도 아깝지 않은 선택입니다.장점을 요약하자면,1.식기 초보자도 어렵지 않는 조작 방식.(설치 기사님이 알려주신대로도 해보고 여러 기능 사용해봤는데 다 쉬워서 따로 익힐게 없어요.)2.14인용이라 넉넉한 사이즈.-왜 주부님들이 가전제품은 무조건 큰거 사라고 하는지 알겠더라고요. 12인용 샀으면 후회할 뻔했어요. 3인가족인데도 요리하면 꽤 설거지 거리가 생기는데 생각보다 꽉 차더라고요. 무조건 14인용 사세요!!!^0^3.심플하고 예쁜 디자인.-딱히 유행을타지 않을 디자인에 집에 있는 인테리어와도 따로 놀지 않고 자연스럽게 어울려서 정말 마음에 듭니다. 컬러도 은은하니 예쁘고 처음 방문하여 보는 사람들은 식기세척기인 줄 모르고 그냥 싱크대인 줄 알아요. 컬러는 [네이처 베이지] 은은하고 연하게 핑크빛이 살짝 도는데 촌스럽지 않고 약간 여성미가 느껴지는 고급스럽게 예쁜 컬러예요. 우리집 싱크대 색상이 화이트에 가까운 아이보리인데 딱히 이질감 없이 잘 어울려요^.^4.살균, 열풍 모드가 있어서 식기에 때 물자국 걱정 없음.-동영상 보시면 아시겠지만 그릇이든 뭐든 딱히 물때 자국 없이 깔끔하게 건조시켜줘서 바로 수납장에 넣으면 되서 참 좋아요. 5.가격 대비 저렴하며 최신식 모델임.-쿠팡이 온라인 가격보다 더 저렴한 편 같고, 최신식 모델이라 기존 식기세척기의 단점은 보안하고 더 업그레이드 되서 좋습니다.6.구매시 몇 만원 추가 결제하면 보험 청구가 가능함.-식기 세척기는 생각보다 고장이 잘난다고 하던데 몇만원만 추가로 구매하면 보험혜택이 있어서 마음에 들었습니다. 단점은지금까지 사용하면서 딱히 못 느껴서 적을게 없네요..만약 후에 생겨나게 되면 추가로 수정해서 올리겠습니다^^결론적으로 식기세척기 첫 구매이고 심사숙고해서 몇 개월만에 픽한 제품인데, 튼튼하고 실용적이여서 정말 추천드립니다.아직도 식기세척기 선택에 고민중이신 분이 계신다면 더 이상 시간낭비 하지마시고,꼭 구매하시길 바래요~~^.^♡

Comments (English): [ My first dishwasher! Design, performance, and efficiency are all top-notch! ] || ---------------- || Hello! I'm a newlywed. I purchased the LG Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher and wanted to write an honest review! Pros: - The sleek, sophisticated design matches the under-sink cabinet! - Washes up to 110 dishes at once! - Energy efficiency rating A++ reduces power consumption and is eco-friendly! - The smart shelf (with a dedicated knife and scissors holder) maximizes interior space! - The noise reduction feature ensures quiet operation! Cons: - Price: The advanced features make it relatively high-priced. - Installation: Because it's built-in, professional installation is required, and compatibility issues with existing kitchens may arise. Reasons for Purchase: I was a firm believer in "no need for a dishwasher, my hands are the best." I also thought it would be more of a chore to just load the dishes into the dishwasher. But the experience was fantastic! Delivery and installation were flawless! I called the day before to confirm, set up an appointment, and the technician showed up! Installation took about 1-2 hours. They explained the operation and important parts, provided a user manual, and even provided instructions for watching a video! The day before delivery, I sent them a photo of the desired installation location, but they said it wasn't wide enough. They asked for a full photo of the kitchen cabinet to see if a different location was possible, so I sent it. Fortunately, they found a location that fit the length, width, and depth, and I was able to install it without a hitch. I was a bit flustered at first, considering returning it, but I highly recommend calling to confirm installation on your sink before purchasing! Incredibly high-performance! - TrueSteam boils water to 100 degrees Celsius, leaving dishes sparkling clean. - TrueDry features condensation drying, automatic door opening drying, and hot air drying to completely dry water. - The water softener reduces limescale in the wash water, even reducing water stains. After the dishes are dry, you can store them in the cabinet without rinsing them. Connects to the Smart ThinQ app! - You can check the product status, such as the cleaning status, with the LG ThinQ app. - They say it suggests sterilizing after using it more than 30 times, but I've only used it less than 10 times so far, so I'll wait and see^^- They even provide instructions on how to easily solve a problem with the product through smart diagnosis! The interior space is also very usable! There are 3 shelves from the top. 1st floor - You can store cooking utensils such as spoons, scissors, and ladles (height adjustable). 2nd floor - You can put bowls, cups, and cutlery here. 3rd floor - You can also load large items such as large pots, large airtight containers, and frying pans that are used in every household! *The rails are not stiff, but very smooth, so there is no feeling of weight or burden. A dishwasher-specific product is essential! I just found out that there is a detergent specifically for dishwashers. Hehehe - Dishwasher Detergent: Dedicated detergent is essential for using a dishwasher in capsule/tablet form. - Dishwasher Salt (Refined Salt): Filling the built-in water softener with dedicated salt will remove stubborn stains that may form during dishwashing! - Dishwasher Rinse: Many rinse aid products are dissolved in detergent these days, so I recommend using them selectively! However, I heard that there is a triple all-in-one detergent that solves all of these problems, so I think it would be good for everyone to consider buying it. ^^ Overall Review: I used the dishwasher without high expectations! The day before delivery, I sent them a photo of the desired installation location, but they said it wasn't wide enough. Fortunately, they found a location that fit the length, width, and depth, and I was able to install it without a hitch. I was a bit flustered at first, considering returning it, but I highly recommend calling to confirm installation on your sink before purchasing! Connects to the Smart ThinQ app! - You can check the product status, such as the cleaning status, with the LG ThinQ app. - They say it suggests sterilizing after using it more than 30 times, but I've only used it less than 10 times so far, so I'll wait and see^^- They even provide instructions on how to easily solve a problem with the product through smart diagnosis! Thanks to it, the dish drying rack above the kitchen table disappeared, and the kitchen looks neat and spacious. It actually saves electricity and water bills compared to doing it by hand. Plus, it saves precious time and energy, which is great! This is my first dishwasher, and I'm so happy with it! If you found my review helpful, please click the "Helpful" button below :)

They explained the operation and important parts, provided a user manual, and even provided instructions for watching a video! They asked for a full photo of the kitchen cabinet to see if a different location was possible, so I sent it. Fortunately, they found a location that fit the length, width, and depth, and I was able to install it without a hitch. I was a bit flustered at first, considering returning it, but I highly recommend calling to confirm installation on your sink before purchasing! Connects to the Smart ThinQ app! - You can check the product status, such as the cleaning status, with the LG ThinQ app. - They say it suggests sterilizing after using it more than 30 times, but I've only used it less than 10 times so far, so I'll wait and see^^- They even provide instructions on how to easily solve a problem with the product through smart diagnosis! They explained the operation and important parts, provided a user manual, and even provided instructions for watching a video! The day before delivery, I sent them a photo of the desired installation location, but they said it wasn't wide enough. They asked for a full photo of the kitchen cabinet to see if a different location was possible, so I sent it. Fortunately, they found a location that fit the length, width, and depth, and I was able to install it without a hitch. I was a bit flustered at first, considering returning it, but I highly recommend calling to confirm installation on your sink before purchasing! Connects to the Smart ThinQ app! - You can check the product status, such as the cleaning status, with the LG ThinQ app. - They say it suggests sterilizing after using it more than 30 times, but I've only used it less than 10 times so far, so I'll wait and see^^- They even provide instructions on how to easily solve a problem with the product through smart diagnosis! The interior space is also very usable! A dishwasher-specific product is essential! I just found out that there is a detergent specifically for dishwashers. Thanks to it, the dish drying rack above the kitchen table disappeared, and the kitchen looks neat and spacious. It actually saves electricity and water bills compared to doing it by hand. Plus, it saves precious time and energy, which is great! This is my first dishwasher, and I'm so happy with it! If you found my review helpful, please click the "Helpful" button below :)
