They explained the operation and important parts, provided a user manual, and even provided instructions for watching a video! The day before delivery, I sent them a photo of the desired installation location, but they said it wasn't wide enough. They asked for a full photo of the kitchen cabinet to see if a different location was possible, so I sent it. Fortunately, they found a location that fit the length, width, and depth, and I was able to install it without a hitch. I was a bit flustered at first, considering returning it, but I highly recommend calling to confirm installation on your sink before purchasing! Incredibly high-performance! - TrueSteam boils water to 100 degrees Celsius, leaving dishes sparkling clean. - TrueDry features condensation drying, automatic door opening drying, and hot air drying to completely dry water. - The water softener reduces limescale in the wash water, even reducing water stains. After the dishes are dry, you can store them in the cabinet without rinsing them. Connects to the Smart ThinQ app! - You can check the product status, such as the cleaning status, with the LG ThinQ app. - They say it suggests sterilizing after using it more than 30 times, but I've only used it less than 10 times so far, so I'll wait and see^^- They even provide instructions on how to easily solve a problem with the product through smart diagnosis! The interior space is also very usable! There are 3 shelves from the top. 1st floor - You can store cooking utensils such as spoons, scissors, and ladles (height adjustable). 2nd floor - You can put bowls, cups, and cutlery here. 3rd floor - You can also load large items such as large pots, large airtight containers, and frying pans that are used in every household! *The rails are not stiff, but very smooth, so there is no feeling of weight or burden. A dishwasher-specific product is essential! I just found out that there is a detergent specifically for dishwashers. Thanks to it, the dish drying rack above the kitchen table disappeared, and the kitchen looks neat and spacious. It actually saves electricity and water bills compared to doing it by hand. Plus, it saves precious time and energy, which is great! This is my first dishwasher, and I'm so happy with it! If you found my review helpful, please click the "Helpful" button below :)

Sentence (English): [[My own money, real review]].
Comments (English): [[My own money, real review]]. This was my first dishwasher purchase, and I was hesitant because it was so expensive, but I've definitely made a good decision. To summarize the pros: 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all so easy there was nothing to learn.) 2. It's spacious enough to accommodate 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying larger appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person unit. Even though we're a family of three, we still have quite a bit of dishes to clean, and it's surprisingly full. Definitely get a 14-person unit! ^0^. 3. Simple and attractive design. - The timeless design blends seamlessly with my home decor, and I really like how it blends in. The subtle, pretty colors are so pretty that first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher. The color is [Nature Beige], a subtle, light pink hue that's not tacky but rather feminine and luxuriously pretty. My sink is a close-to-white ivory, so it blends in well without any noticeable dissonance. 4. It has a sterilization and hot air mode, so there's no need to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other items cleanly without any water marks, so I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and a state-of-the-art model. - Coupang prices are cheaper than online prices, and since it's a state-of-the-art model, it's nice that it addresses the shortcomings of existing dishwashers and provides a more upgraded version. 6. You can file an insurance claim for an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - Dishwashers are often more prone to breaking down than you might think, so I'm happy to add insurance benefits for just a few tens of thousands of won. As for the downsides, I haven't noticed any while using it, so I can't list any. If I encounter any downsides in the future, I'll update and post a more detailed review. In conclusion, this is my first dishwasher purchase, and after months of careful consideration, I chose this one. It's sturdy and practical, so I highly recommend it. If you're still undecided about which dishwasher to buy, don't waste any more time. I urge you to buy it!
Comments (Original): [[내돈 내산, 리얼 후기]]식기세척기 처음 구매이고 거금이라 고민 많이 했었는데 돈이 하나도 아깝지 않은 선택입니다.장점을 요약하자면,1.식기 초보자도 어렵지 않는 조작 방식.(설치 기사님이 알려주신대로도 해보고 여러 기능 사용해봤는데 다 쉬워서 따로 익힐게 없어요.)2.14인용이라 넉넉한 사이즈.-왜 주부님들이 가전제품은 무조건 큰거 사라고 하는지 알겠더라고요. 12인용 샀으면 후회할 뻔했어요. 3인가족인데도 요리하면 꽤 설거지 거리가 생기는데 생각보다 꽉 차더라고요. 무조건 14인용 사세요!!!^0^3.심플하고 예쁜 디자인.-딱히 유행을타지 않을 디자인에 집에 있는 인테리어와도 따로 놀지 않고 자연스럽게 어울려서 정말 마음에 듭니다. 컬러도 은은하니 예쁘고 처음 방문하여 보는 사람들은 식기세척기인 줄 모르고 그냥 싱크대인 줄 알아요. 컬러는 [네이처 베이지] 은은하고 연하게 핑크빛이 살짝 도는데 촌스럽지 않고 약간 여성미가 느껴지는 고급스럽게 예쁜 컬러예요. 우리집 싱크대 색상이 화이트에 가까운 아이보리인데 딱히 이질감 없이 잘 어울려요^.^4.살균, 열풍 모드가 있어서 식기에 때 물자국 걱정 없음.-동영상 보시면 아시겠지만 그릇이든 뭐든 딱히 물때 자국 없이 깔끔하게 건조시켜줘서 바로 수납장에 넣으면 되서 참 좋아요. 5.가격 대비 저렴하며 최신식 모델임.-쿠팡이 온라인 가격보다 더 저렴한 편 같고, 최신식 모델이라 기존 식기세척기의 단점은 보안하고 더 업그레이드 되서 좋습니다.6.구매시 몇 만원 추가 결제하면 보험 청구가 가능함.-식기 세척기는 생각보다 고장이 잘난다고 하던데 몇만원만 추가로 구매하면 보험혜택이 있어서 마음에 들었습니다. 단점은지금까지 사용하면서 딱히 못 느껴서 적을게 없네요..만약 후에 생겨나게 되면 추가로 수정해서 올리겠습니다^^결론적으로 식기세척기 첫 구매이고 심사숙고해서 몇 개월만에 픽한 제품인데, 튼튼하고 실용적이여서 정말 추천드립니다.아직도 식기세척기 선택에 고민중이신 분이 계신다면 더 이상 시간낭비 하지마시고,꼭 구매하시길 바래요~~^.^♡

To summarize the pros: 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all so easy there was nothing to learn.) 2. It's spacious enough to accommodate 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying larger appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person unit. Even though we're a family of three, we still have quite a bit of dishes to clean, and it's surprisingly full. Definitely get a 14-person unit! ^0^. 3. Simple and attractive design. - The timeless design blends seamlessly with my home decor, and I really like how it blends in. The subtle, pretty colors are so pretty that first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher. The color is [Nature Beige], a subtle, light pink hue that's not tacky but rather feminine and luxuriously pretty. My sink is a close-to-white ivory, so it blends in well without any noticeable dissonance. 4. It has a sterilization and hot air mode, so there's no need to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other items cleanly without any water marks, so I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and a state-of-the-art model. - Coupang prices are cheaper than online prices, and since it's a state-of-the-art model, it's nice that it addresses the shortcomings of existing dishwashers and provides a more upgraded version. 6. You can file an insurance claim for an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - Dishwashers are often more prone to breaking down than you might think, so I'm happy to add insurance benefits for just a few tens of thousands of won. As for the downsides, I haven't noticed any while using it, so I can't list any. If I encounter any downsides in the future, I'll update and post a more detailed review. In conclusion, this is my first dishwasher purchase, and after months of careful consideration, I chose this one. It's sturdy and practical, so I highly recommend it. If you're still undecided about which dishwasher to buy, don't waste any more time. I urge you to buy it!
Comments (Original): [[내돈 내산, 리얼 후기]]식기세척기 처음 구매이고 거금이라 고민 많이 했었는데 돈이 하나도 아깝지 않은 선택입니다.장점을 요약하자면,1.식기 초보자도 어렵지 않는 조작 방식.(설치 기사님이 알려주신대로도 해보고 여러 기능 사용해봤는데 다 쉬워서 따로 익힐게 없어요.)2.14인용이라 넉넉한 사이즈.-왜 주부님들이 가전제품은 무조건 큰거 사라고 하는지 알겠더라고요. 12인용 샀으면 후회할 뻔했어요. 3인가족인데도 요리하면 꽤 설거지 거리가 생기는데 생각보다 꽉 차더라고요. 무조건 14인용 사세요!!!^0^3.심플하고 예쁜 디자인.-딱히 유행을타지 않을 디자인에 집에 있는 인테리어와도 따로 놀지 않고 자연스럽게 어울려서 정말 마음에 듭니다. 컬러도 은은하니 예쁘고 처음 방문하여 보는 사람들은 식기세척기인 줄 모르고 그냥 싱크대인 줄 알아요. 컬러는 [네이처 베이지] 은은하고 연하게 핑크빛이 살짝 도는데 촌스럽지 않고 약간 여성미가 느껴지는 고급스럽게 예쁜 컬러예요. 우리집 싱크대 색상이 화이트에 가까운 아이보리인데 딱히 이질감 없이 잘 어울려요^.^4.살균, 열풍 모드가 있어서 식기에 때 물자국 걱정 없음.-동영상 보시면 아시겠지만 그릇이든 뭐든 딱히 물때 자국 없이 깔끔하게 건조시켜줘서 바로 수납장에 넣으면 되서 참 좋아요. 5.가격 대비 저렴하며 최신식 모델임.-쿠팡이 온라인 가격보다 더 저렴한 편 같고, 최신식 모델이라 기존 식기세척기의 단점은 보안하고 더 업그레이드 되서 좋습니다.6.구매시 몇 만원 추가 결제하면 보험 청구가 가능함.-식기 세척기는 생각보다 고장이 잘난다고 하던데 몇만원만 추가로 구매하면 보험혜택이 있어서 마음에 들었습니다. 단점은지금까지 사용하면서 딱히 못 느껴서 적을게 없네요..만약 후에 생겨나게 되면 추가로 수정해서 올리겠습니다^^결론적으로 식기세척기 첫 구매이고 심사숙고해서 몇 개월만에 픽한 제품인데, 튼튼하고 실용적이여서 정말 추천드립니다.아직도 식기세척기 선택에 고민중이신 분이 계신다면 더 이상 시간낭비 하지마시고,꼭 구매하시길 바래요~~^.^♡

To summarize the pros: 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all so easy there was nothing to learn.) 2. It's spacious enough to accommodate 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying larger appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person unit. Even though we're a family of three, we still have quite a bit of dishes to clean, and it's surprisingly full. Definitely get a 14-person unit! ^0^. 3. Simple and attractive design. - The timeless design blends seamlessly with my home decor, and I really like how it blends in. The subtle, pretty colors are so pretty that first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher. The color is [Nature Beige], a subtle, light pink hue that's not tacky but rather feminine and luxuriously pretty. My sink is a close-to-white ivory, so it blends in well without any noticeable dissonance. 4. It has a sterilization and hot air mode, so there's no need to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other items cleanly without any water marks, so I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and a state-of-the-art model. - Coupang prices are cheaper than online prices, and since it's a state-of-the-art model, it's nice that it addresses the shortcomings of existing dishwashers and provides a more upgraded version. 6. You can file an insurance claim for an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - Dishwashers are often more prone to breaking down than you might think, so I'm happy to add insurance benefits for just a few tens of thousands of won. As for the downsides, I haven't noticed any while using it, so I can't list any. If I encounter any downsides in the future, I'll update and post a more detailed review. In conclusion, this is my first dishwasher purchase, and after months of careful consideration, I chose this one. It's sturdy and practical, so I highly recommend it. If you're still undecided about which dishwasher to buy, don't waste any more time. I urge you to buy it!
Comments (Original): [[내돈 내산, 리얼 후기]]식기세척기 처음 구매이고 거금이라 고민 많이 했었는데 돈이 하나도 아깝지 않은 선택입니다.장점을 요약하자면,1.식기 초보자도 어렵지 않는 조작 방식.(설치 기사님이 알려주신대로도 해보고 여러 기능 사용해봤는데 다 쉬워서 따로 익힐게 없어요.)2.14인용이라 넉넉한 사이즈.-왜 주부님들이 가전제품은 무조건 큰거 사라고 하는지 알겠더라고요. 12인용 샀으면 후회할 뻔했어요. 3인가족인데도 요리하면 꽤 설거지 거리가 생기는데 생각보다 꽉 차더라고요. 무조건 14인용 사세요!!!^0^3.심플하고 예쁜 디자인.-딱히 유행을타지 않을 디자인에 집에 있는 인테리어와도 따로 놀지 않고 자연스럽게 어울려서 정말 마음에 듭니다. 컬러도 은은하니 예쁘고 처음 방문하여 보는 사람들은 식기세척기인 줄 모르고 그냥 싱크대인 줄 알아요. 컬러는 [네이처 베이지] 은은하고 연하게 핑크빛이 살짝 도는데 촌스럽지 않고 약간 여성미가 느껴지는 고급스럽게 예쁜 컬러예요. 우리집 싱크대 색상이 화이트에 가까운 아이보리인데 딱히 이질감 없이 잘 어울려요^.^4.살균, 열풍 모드가 있어서 식기에 때 물자국 걱정 없음.-동영상 보시면 아시겠지만 그릇이든 뭐든 딱히 물때 자국 없이 깔끔하게 건조시켜줘서 바로 수납장에 넣으면 되서 참 좋아요. 5.가격 대비 저렴하며 최신식 모델임.-쿠팡이 온라인 가격보다 더 저렴한 편 같고, 최신식 모델이라 기존 식기세척기의 단점은 보안하고 더 업그레이드 되서 좋습니다.6.구매시 몇 만원 추가 결제하면 보험 청구가 가능함.-식기 세척기는 생각보다 고장이 잘난다고 하던데 몇만원만 추가로 구매하면 보험혜택이 있어서 마음에 들었습니다. 단점은지금까지 사용하면서 딱히 못 느껴서 적을게 없네요..만약 후에 생겨나게 되면 추가로 수정해서 올리겠습니다^^결론적으로 식기세척기 첫 구매이고 심사숙고해서 몇 개월만에 픽한 제품인데, 튼튼하고 실용적이여서 정말 추천드립니다.아직도 식기세척기 선택에 고민중이신 분이 계신다면 더 이상 시간낭비 하지마시고,꼭 구매하시길 바래요~~^.^♡

The subtle, pretty colors are so pretty that first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher. The color is [Nature Beige], a subtle, light pink hue that's not tacky but rather feminine and luxuriously pretty. My sink is a close-to-white ivory, so it blends in well without any noticeable dissonance. 4. It has a sterilization and hot air mode, so there's no need to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other items cleanly without any water marks, so I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. You can file an insurance claim for an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - Dishwashers are often more prone to breaking down than you might think, so I'm happy to add insurance benefits for just a few tens of thousands of won. As for the downsides, I haven't noticed any while using it, so I can't list any. If I encounter any downsides in the future, I'll update and post a more detailed review. In conclusion, this is my first dishwasher purchase, and after months of careful consideration, I chose this one. It's sturdy and practical, so I highly recommend it. If you're still undecided about which dishwasher to buy, don't waste any more time. I urge you to buy it!

Comments (English): [[My own money, real review]]. This was my first dishwasher purchase, and I was hesitant because it was so expensive, but I've definitely made a good decision. To summarize the pros: 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all so easy there was nothing to learn.) 2. It's spacious enough to accommodate 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying larger appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person unit. Even though we're a family of three, we still have quite a bit of dishes to clean, and it's surprisingly full. Definitely get a 14-person unit! ^0^. 3. Simple and attractive design. - The timeless design blends seamlessly with my home decor, and I really like how it blends in. The subtle, pretty colors are so pretty that first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher. The color is [Nature Beige], a subtle, light pink hue that's not tacky but rather feminine and luxuriously pretty. My sink is a close-to-white ivory, so it blends in well without any noticeable dissonance. 4. It has a sterilization and hot air mode, so there's no need to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other items cleanly without any water marks, so I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and a state-of-the-art model. - Coupang prices are cheaper than online prices, and since it's a state-of-the-art model, it's nice that it addresses the shortcomings of existing dishwashers and provides a more upgraded version. 6. You can file an insurance claim for an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - Dishwashers are often more prone to breaking down than you might think, so I'm happy to add insurance benefits for just a few tens of thousands of won. As for the downsides, I haven't noticed any while using it, so I can't list any. If I encounter any downsides in the future, I'll update and post a more detailed review. In conclusion, this is my first dishwasher purchase, and after months of careful consideration, I chose this one. It's sturdy and practical, so I highly recommend it. If you're still undecided about which dishwasher to buy, don't waste any more time. I urge you to buy it!

To summarize the pros: 1. The operation is easy even for beginners. (I followed the installer's instructions and tried out various functions, and they were all so easy there was nothing to learn.) 2. It's spacious enough to accommodate 14 people. - I now understand why housewives always recommend buying larger appliances. I almost regretted buying a 12-person unit. Even though we're a family of three, we still have quite a bit of dishes to clean, and it's surprisingly full. Definitely get a 14-person unit! ^0^. 3. Simple and attractive design. - The timeless design blends seamlessly with my home decor, and I really like how it blends in. The subtle, pretty colors are so pretty that first-time visitors often mistake it for a dishwasher. The color is [Nature Beige], a subtle, light pink hue that's not tacky but rather feminine and luxuriously pretty. My sink is a close-to-white ivory, so it blends in well without any noticeable dissonance. 4. It has a sterilization and hot air mode, so there's no need to worry about stains on your dishes. - As you can see in the video, it dries dishes and other items cleanly without any water marks, so I can just put them back in the cabinet. 5. It's affordable and a state-of-the-art model. - Coupang prices are cheaper than online prices, and since it's a state-of-the-art model, it's nice that it addresses the shortcomings of existing dishwashers and provides a more upgraded version. 6. You can file an insurance claim for an additional tens of thousands of won when purchasing. - Dishwashers are often more prone to breaking down than you might think, so I'm happy to add insurance benefits for just a few tens of thousands of won. As for the downsides, I haven't noticed any while using it, so I can't list any. If I encounter any downsides in the future, I'll update and post a more detailed review. In conclusion, this is my first dishwasher purchase, and after months of careful consideration, I chose this one. It's sturdy and practical, so I highly recommend it. If you're still undecided about which dishwasher to buy, don't waste any more time. I urge you to buy it!
Comments (Original): [[내돈 내산, 리얼 후기]]식기세척기 처음 구매이고 거금이라 고민 많이 했었는데 돈이 하나도 아깝지 않은 선택입니다.장점을 요약하자면,1.식기 초보자도 어렵지 않는 조작 방식.(설치 기사님이 알려주신대로도 해보고 여러 기능 사용해봤는데 다 쉬워서 따로 익힐게 없어요.)2.14인용이라 넉넉한 사이즈.-왜 주부님들이 가전제품은 무조건 큰거 사라고 하는지 알겠더라고요. 12인용 샀으면 후회할 뻔했어요. 3인가족인데도 요리하면 꽤 설거지 거리가 생기는데 생각보다 꽉 차더라고요. 무조건 14인용 사세요!!!^0^3.심플하고 예쁜 디자인.-딱히 유행을타지 않을 디자인에 집에 있는 인테리어와도 따로 놀지 않고 자연스럽게 어울려서 정말 마음에 듭니다. 컬러도 은은하니 예쁘고 처음 방문하여 보는 사람들은 식기세척기인 줄 모르고 그냥 싱크대인 줄 알아요. 컬러는 [네이처 베이지] 은은하고 연하게 핑크빛이 살짝 도는데 촌스럽지 않고 약간 여성미가 느껴지는 고급스럽게 예쁜 컬러예요. 우리집 싱크대 색상이 화이트에 가까운 아이보리인데 딱히 이질감 없이 잘 어울려요^.^4.살균, 열풍 모드가 있어서 식기에 때 물자국 걱정 없음.-동영상 보시면 아시겠지만 그릇이든 뭐든 딱히 물때 자국 없이 깔끔하게 건조시켜줘서 바로 수납장에 넣으면 되서 참 좋아요. 5.가격 대비 저렴하며 최신식 모델임.-쿠팡이 온라인 가격보다 더 저렴한 편 같고, 최신식 모델이라 기존 식기세척기의 단점은 보안하고 더 업그레이드 되서 좋습니다.6.구매시 몇 만원 추가 결제하면 보험 청구가 가능함.-식기 세척기는 생각보다 고장이 잘난다고 하던데 몇만원만 추가로 구매하면 보험혜택이 있어서 마음에 들었습니다. 단점은지금까지 사용하면서 딱히 못 느껴서 적을게 없네요..만약 후에 생겨나게 되면 추가로 수정해서 올리겠습니다^^결론적으로 식기세척기 첫 구매이고 심사숙고해서 몇 개월만에 픽한 제품인데, 튼튼하고 실용적이여서 정말 추천드립니다.아직도 식기세척기 선택에 고민중이신 분이 계신다면 더 이상 시간낭비 하지마시고,꼭 구매하시길 바래요~~^.^♡

I purchased the LG Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher and wanted to write an honest review! Pros: - The sleek, sophisticated design matches the under-sink cabinet! - Washes up to 110 dishes at once! - Energy efficiency rating A++ reduces power consumption and is eco-friendly! - The smart shelf (with a dedicated knife and scissors holder) maximizes interior space! - The noise reduction function ensures quiet operation! Cons: - Price: The advanced features make it relatively high. - Installation: Because it's built-in, professional installation is required, and compatibility issues with existing kitchens may arise. Reason for purchase: I was always wary of "I don't need a dishwasher" and "I'm the best at what I do." I also thought it would be more work to just stack the dishes in the dishwasher. But the experience was fantastic! Delivery and installation were flawless! I called the day before to confirm, set up an appointment, and the technician came! Installation took approximately 1-2 hours. They explained the operation and important parts, and provided a user manual and a video tutorial! The day before delivery, I sent them a photo of the desired installation location, but they said it wasn't wide enough. They asked for a full photo of the kitchen cabinet to see if a different location was possible, so I sent it. Fortunately, there was a location that fit the length, width, and depth, so I installed it without a hitch. At first, I was a little perplexed and considered getting a refund, but... Before purchasing, I highly recommend calling to confirm installation on your sink if possible! Incredibly high-performance! - TrueSteam boils water to 100 degrees Celsius, leaving dishes sparkling clean. - TrueDry features condensation drying, automatic door opening drying, and hot air drying to completely dry water. - The water softener reduces limescale in the wash water and even water stains, so you can store your dishes right away without rinsing them. Connects to the Smart ThinQ app! - You can check the product status, such as the cleaning status, with the LG ThinQ app. - It suggests full sterilization after 30 uses, but I've only used it less than 10 times so far, so I'll keep an eye on it^^. - It even provides instructions on how to easily resolve a problem with the product through smart diagnosis! The interior space is also very usable! There are 1-2-3 shelves from the top. 1st floor - You can store cooking utensils such as spoons, scissors, and ladles (height adjustable). 2nd floor - You can put dishes, cups, and cutlery here. 3rd floor - You can also load large items used in every household, such as large pots, large airtight containers, and frying pans! *The rails are not stiff, but very smooth, so there is no feeling of heaviness or burden. Dishwasher-specific products are essential! I just found out that there is a dishwasher-specific detergent. Hehe. - Dishwasher-specific detergent: Detergent for using a dishwasher in capsule/tablet form is essential. - Dishwasher salt (refined salt): Filling the built-in water softener with this special salt will remove stubborn stains that can form during dishwashing! - Dishwasher rinse aid: Many rinse aid products are dissolved in detergent these days, so I recommend using it selectively! However, I heard that there's a triple-all-in-one detergent that solves all of these problems, so I think it's worth considering and purchasing. ^^. Overall Review. I tried the dishwasher without high expectations! Thanks to it, the dish drying rack above the kitchen table has disappeared, and the kitchen looks neat and spacious. They say it actually saves electricity and water compared to doing it by hand. Plus, it saves precious time and energy, which is great. This is my first dishwasher, and I'm so happy with it! The day before delivery, I sent them a photo of the desired installation location, but they said it wasn't wide enough. Fortunately, there was a location that fit the length, width, and depth, so I installed it without a hitch. At first, I was a little perplexed and considered getting a refund, but... Before purchasing, I highly recommend calling to confirm installation on your sink if possible! Connects to the Smart ThinQ app! - You can check the product status, such as the cleaning status, with the LG ThinQ app. - It suggests full sterilization after 30 uses, but I've only used it less than 10 times so far, so I'll keep an eye on it^^. - It even provides instructions on how to easily resolve a problem with the product through smart diagnosis! Dishwasher-specific products are essential! I just found out that there is a dishwasher-specific detergent. Hehe. - Dishwasher-specific detergent: Detergent for using a dishwasher in capsule/tablet form is essential. - Dishwasher salt (refined salt): Filling the built-in water softener with this special salt will remove stubborn stains that can form during dishwashing! - Dishwasher rinse aid: Many rinse aid products are dissolved in detergent these days, so I recommend using it selectively! I tried the dishwasher without high expectations! Thanks to it, the dish drying rack above the kitchen table has disappeared, and the kitchen looks neat and spacious. They say it actually saves electricity and water compared to doing it by hand. Plus, it saves precious time and energy, which is great. This is my first dishwasher, and I'm so happy with it! But the experience was fantastic! Delivery and installation were flawless! I called the day before to confirm, set up an appointment, and the technician came! The day before delivery, I sent them a photo of the desired installation location, but they said it wasn't wide enough. Fortunately, there was a location that fit the length, width, and depth, so I installed it without a hitch. At first, I was a little perplexed and considered getting a refund, but... Before purchasing, I highly recommend calling to confirm installation on your sink if possible! Connects to the Smart ThinQ app! - You can check the product status, such as the cleaning status, with the LG ThinQ app. - It suggests full sterilization after 30 uses, but I've only used it less than 10 times so far, so I'll keep an eye on it^^. - It even provides instructions on how to easily resolve a problem with the product through smart diagnosis! The interior space is also very usable! Dishwasher-specific products are essential! I just found out that there is a dishwasher-specific detergent. Hehe. - Dishwasher-specific detergent: Detergent for using a dishwasher in capsule/tablet form is essential. - Dishwasher salt (refined salt): Filling the built-in water softener with this special salt will remove stubborn stains that can form during dishwashing! - Dishwasher rinse aid: Many rinse aid products are dissolved in detergent these days, so I recommend using it selectively! However, I heard that there's a triple-all-in-one detergent that solves all of these problems, so I think it's worth considering and purchasing. ^^. Overall Review. I tried the dishwasher without high expectations! Thanks to it, the dish drying rack above the kitchen table has disappeared, and the kitchen looks neat and spacious. They say it actually saves electricity and water compared to doing it by hand. Plus, it saves precious time and energy, which is great. This is my first dishwasher, and I'm so happy with it! Sentence (English): I bought this to replace an old failing dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher, bad installation experience ] || ---------------- || I bought this to replace an old failing dishwasher. It cleans far better than the old one and it runs very quiet. The top rack work great for coffee mugs and cups (mostly). It doesn't fit some of my non-standard sized coffee cups which I have many of so I end up putting those on the middle rack. Speaking of the middle rack, it does need to be raised all the way up if you plan on cleaning a cookie sheet on the bottom rack. I do this fairly often so the middle rack is usually always in the fully up position. Occasionally this means that some bowls or containers in the middle rack will interfere with the top rack so I have to fiddle with the placement of things. The adjustable spines on the middle rack are nice in theory but are rarely useful. There's only one adjustable spine on each rack, so it's not like you can fill the whole bottom rack with big pots and pans. Another reason I picked this over some others is the LACK of wifi or any kind of connectivity. No thanks, I don't want my dishwasher on the internet. I don't want to pull out my phone to change the cleaning cycle. The controls on this are perfect. Just push the cycle and hit start. The most unfortunate part of buying this machine was the installation. This has nothing to do with the machine and everything to do with the installation company. Even though I had an existing dishwasher with perfectly capable plumbing, the installation company refused to install the new machine and left. I had to hire a local plumber to install the new machine at my own expense. In fairness, Costco did offer me a small reimbursement after I contacted customer service and told them about the ordeal.

Sentence (English): I previously used an older Bosch model of a compact machine, but unfortunately it broke down after 20 years of constant use.
Comments (English): [ Poor functionality ] || ---------------- || I previously used an older Bosch model of a compact machine, but unfortunately it broke down after 20 years of constant use. I bought a new one because it is practically the only one of this size on the market. Unfortunately, I am very disappointed. 1. The control buttons are on the bottom side, so you have to bend down completely, and the display is also less visible. 2. The machine slides back and forth on the drawer because it does not have rubber feet. 3. The new model is 5 cm longer, so I had to redo the built-in niche in the counter, which was quite a problem. 4. The main drawback is: The dish basket was obviously designed by someone who has never used a compact dishwasher before. It is to be expected that such a machine will most likely be used in a small kitchenette, e.g. in the office, i.e. mainly for glasses, cups and some plates and utensils. However, the wires on the basket are so sparse that glasses and cups and even smaller bowls fall through on most surfaces. The accessory basket should be placed somewhere in the back of the drawer, where it is difficult to fill. It's as if the whole basket is meant just for pots and bowls. Every time I fill it, I'm afraid something will leak through.
Comments (Original): [ Slaba funkcionalnost ] || ---------------- || Prej sem uporabljal starejši Boschev model kompaktnega stroja, ki pa se je 20 letih stalne uporabe žal pokvaril. Kupil sem novega, ker je praktično edini take velikosti na trgu. Žal sem zelo razočaran. 1. Gumbi za upravljanje so na spodnji strani in se je treba zato povsem skloniti, pa še displej je slabše viden.2. Stroj drsi naprej in nazaj po predalu, ker nima gumijastih nožic. 3. Novi model je 5 cm daljši, zato sem moral predelati vgradno nišo v pultu, kar je bil precejšen problem.4. Glavna pomanjkljivost pa je: Košaro za posodo je očitno zasnoval nekdo, ki še ni uporabljal kompaktnega pomivalnega stroja. Za pričakovati je, da bo tak stroj najverjetnje uporabljen v mali čajni kuhinji npr. v pisarni, torej predvsem za kozarce, skodelice in nekaj krožnikov ter pribora. Vendar so žice na košari tako redke, da kozarci in skodelice in celo manjše sklede na večini površine padejo skozi. Košarico za pribor pa je treba dati nekam v ozadje predala, kjer jo je težko polniti. Kot da je cela košara mišljena samo za lonce in sklede. Vsakič, ko jo polnim, se bojim da bo kaj ušlo skozi.

Sentence (English): Replaced a 14 year old GE Dishwasher with a Whirlpool WDPA70SAMZ.
Comments (English): [ Wet Dishes, Can't wash Stemware, lacking manuals ] || ---------------- || Replaced a 14 year old GE Dishwasher with a Whirlpool WDPA70SAMZ. Some of the issues I have; 1) It does not dry the dishes even on a heat cycle. I have run the service test code/cycle and everything checks out. But after over 3 hours runtime on a NORMAL wash cycle with heat selected, the entire inside of the dishwasher is wet. I open the door and water runs down the door, all dishes are soaked. Feel like I have to be home to babysit the dishwasher now and take dishes out when the cycle completes. Already looking for a new one after only 2 weeks. 2) cannot wash stemware without the stemware flopping all over the rack and risking breaking. So I'm back to handwashing stemware with this dishwasher. 3) Included / downloadable manuals are limited at best. For example there is a light on the front that randomly lights and changes color but I can't find anything that tells me what this means. Nothing to explain the difference between Heated Dry and Extend Heat. But the Extend Heat option only adds 5 minutes for heavy cycles, or 15 minutes for normal cycle. As wet as the inside is I don't see where 5 or 15 minutes will make a difference. I should have just invested the $50 to fix my old GE.

Sentence (English): Does everything we expected.
Comments (English): [ Cleans quietly ] || ---------------- || Does everything we expected. I chose this Bosch 800 series dishwasher because I read great reviews about its cleaning ability and quietness. So far (a month in) it hasn't disappointed. We are still getting use to needing to use the app for delayed start (wish we could push buttons on it for that) but there are some convenient features. Setting a start range so it begins during non-peak hours, tablet counter to track how many pods we have left so I can order ahead, and a text notification when it's done and I can empty it. I wouldn't even know otherwise, since it's SO quiet! We upgraded from a different brand that was 10+ yrs old so this was great with such an improvement overall especially on sound level, cleaning, and extra third row. I highly recommend it! In fact my parents have a Bosch and love theirs too and had recommended it. We installed it ourselves and got some great tips from the delivery drivers (Home Depot). I think it was easy enough but we aren't pro's so it took us probably 4hours (because we had to drill a bigger hole and such for the waterline since it was bigger than the previous) but now we know where everything goes if there is an issue later. :)

Sentence (English): I bought this Bosch 800 series to replace a high-end KitchenAid.
Comments (English): [ Cleans great, super quiet, fast, but odd racks. ] || ---------------- || I bought this Bosch 800 series to replace a high-end KitchenAid. The K/A failed at less than 4 years. The LED panel cracked a month out of warranty, and at about 45mo the main pump died. Local repair guy quoted me $800 to repair, and told me to get a Bosch instead, which is what I did. Pro Tip 1 - go on the Bosch website and request a brochure. It includes a very helpful model number breakdown that you can use to determine what year the dishwasher was released, and if it is a first or second generation for that year. This one was a model year behind and Best Buy had a great price on it! The good:. This is a very well-made dishwasher. The door and handle make the other brands feel like toys. It is super quiet when running, although it is slightly louder when it drains. Cleaning quality is amazing. It dries well enough I have not had to use the premium drying feature. The 800 series (mine, at least) has a built in water softener salt dispenser, if you have harder water. Unlike the other brands I have used (Kennmore, LG and KitchenAid) the Bosch is completely enclosed, which I think aids in it being so quiet. It remembers your last cycle, so to just repeat is two buttons (power then start). This is really convenient. You cannot see the top controls when the door is closed, but it projects a red dot on the floor while running. A normal cycle with sanitize and heavy scrub takes 2hrs 43min, so more than an hour faster than the K/A. Did I mention how well it cleans? Everything comes out great, and I am not one to pre-rinse (that's the dishwasher's job, right? ). Pro Tip 2 - Bosch (at least this unit) has an in-line regulator on the incoming water supply. This is very good, because it protects the dishwasher from over-pressure. It does mean that your existing water supply line probably will need some reducers or special fittings to mate up with the Bosch, and you're going to need room for it behind the dishwasher (roughly 3\" wide x 4\" long x 2\" thick, if I remember correctly). The bad:. Google \"how to load a Bosch 800 series\" and marvel at the responses. After a few weeks I've figured out the best way for my dishes, but the K/A racks are vastly superior. It's like the Bosch racks were designed by someone who thinks all dishes are plates and they've never seen a bowl. This seems smaller in the interior than previous dishwashers. K/A's top rack was large enough for standard glasses at an angle. The Bosch top rack is too shallow for a serving spoon on its side. That being said, this is what I've learned to do:. Top rack = silverware (I actually do not use the silverware basket) and serving stuff. Middle rack = cups, glasses, bowls. Bottom rack = plates and cookware. At the end of the day, because of the poor rack design you sometimes ending up needing to do 2 loads for what you could have fit in one K/A. But since the $1200 K/A didn't even last 4 years I'll tolerate having an extra load from time to time. The ugly:. Nothing ugly about this dishwasher. What about Best Buy? It would be wrong of me not to mention the great job the Best Buy installation crew did. They were available to install earlier than estimated. They confirmed an appointment window the day before, and let me know when they were about 15min out. They had the old unit removed and the new one installed in a couple of hours, and that included changing the electric and dealing with the odd size water inlet. I waited until this unit had free installation, and with that and the sale, Best Buy really had a very attractive price.

Everything comes out great, and I am not one to pre-rinse (that's the dishwasher's job, right?).Pro Tip 2 - Bosch (at least this unit) has an in-line regulator on the incoming water supply.  This is very good, because it protects the dishwasher from over-pressure.  It does mean that your existing water supply line probably will need some reducers or special fittings to mate up with the Bosch, and you're going to need room for it behind the dishwasher (roughly 3\' wide x 4\' long x 2\' thick, if I remember correctly).The bad:Google \'how to load a Bosch 800 series\' and marvel at the responses.  After a few weeks I've figured out the best way for my dishes, but the K/A racks are vastly superior.  It's like the Bosch racks were designed by someone who thinks all dishes are plates and they've never seen a bowl.  This seems smaller in the interior than previous dishwashers.  K/A's top rack was large enough for standard glasses at an angle.  The Bosch top rack is too shallow for a serving spoon on its side.  That being said, this is what I've learned to do:Top rack = silverware (I actually do not use the silverware basket) and serving stuff.Middle rack = cups, glasses, bowls.Bottom rack = plates and cookware.At the end of the day, because of the poor rack design you sometimes ending up needing to do 2 loads for what you could have fit in one K/A.  But since the $1200 K/A didn't even last 4 years I'll tolerate having an extra load from time to time.The ugly:Nothing ugly about this dishwasher.What about Best Buy?It would be wrong of me not to mention the great job the Best Buy installation crew did.  They were available to install earlier than estimated.  They confirmed an appointment window the day before, and let me know when they were about 15min out.  They had the old unit removed and the new one installed in a couple of hours, and that included changing the electric and dealing with the odd size water inlet.  I waited until this unit had free installation, and with that and the sale, Best Buy really had a very attractive price.

Sentence (English): Had the product for 20 months.
Comments (English): [ Has to be rebuilt in less than 2 years ] || ---------------- || Had the product for 20 months. I've had to make several calls to customer service for various reasons. Got a CF error code on the door display and on the app meaning the condenser fan wasn't working. Had a service call and was told the fan and compressor needed to be replaced. When the tech went to order the parts - LG told him to rebuild the unit as the evaporator would fail in the future. 4 different parts have been delivered to my house and the tech is bringing 2 more to completely rebuild the refrigerator. I contacted LG to ask for a refund or new unit and was told "the unit had to be fixed" and no refund or new unit would be approved. I asked that my warranty period be extended and was told that was not an option either. I know they don't make them like they used to but I would certainly expect it to last more than 20 months and NOT have to have parts replaced. Hoping the dishwasher I recently bought from LG doesn't have the same kind of problems. Will not purchase another LG product.

Sentence (English): Have recently purchased & installed this dishwasher & overall it's a pretty great product.
Comments (English): [ Great clean, not so great dry ] || ---------------- || Have recently purchased & installed this dishwasher & overall it's a pretty great product. I knew that Bosch has a great reputation for quality appliances so I didn't mind paying a little extra for something that would last. Only thing I'm a little less than impressed with is the drying. Basically since it doesn't have a heating element, it uses steam from the ambient hot water to dry the dishes. But if you don't unload it for a few hours after it's done it will cool & the steam will turn to water & everything will become drenched again. So if you run it overnight & hope to unload it in the morning, well you'll be in for a surprise. Never thought a dishwasher would not come with a heating element, but I guess I was wrong. I think I've figured out how to work with this one as it is, but if/when I get another dishwasher, I'm going to make sure it has a heating element because that's just more effective in my experience.

It is so quiet you absolutely need the red light indicator shining on the floor beneath it to know its status. Our old dishwasher had failed and leaked water all over the wood floor after 10 years and we are now so glad as it led us to this giant step forward with the new Bosch. The controls are simple, although an acknowledgement of the resume button when interupting to add an item might help (it took us a while to figure out you have to hit the resume versus just re-closing the door like our old washer). One suggestion to the design team is to provide an easier indication of the full level of the rinse-aid. But overall we love it.

Comments (English): [ Disappoints in every way ] || ---------------- || I purchased this Bosch 100 Series Model SHE3AEM2N, confident of its reliability and superior quality, based on Bosch's long-standing excellent reputation for excellent products. I paid $699.99, excluding tax and delivery. When delivered, there was a dent on the top, despite good packaging. The first problem was my dishes were left sopping wet with cloudy water, as was the entire interior, with puddling on the bottom. The bottoms of my clear glasses were left cloudy, despite my rinsing them beforehand.I tried the extra heat setting with no improvement. The service men I called were not Bosch specialists, but immediately informed me that a rinsing agent (not cheap) was necessary to dry the dishes. The manual states \"for OPTIMAL [drying] results, add rinse aid\". That is not only blatantly misleading, it is laughable, considering my accurate and unembellished description above. It also completely fails to address that the \"nonoptimal' drying involves leaving a cloudy liquid all over the inside. Despite rinsing and scrubbing my dishes and flatware to remove food residue, using an approved liquid DW detergent and the same Rinse Aid product the came with the DW, they routinely come out with lightly soiled. Unless I leave the door opened for an hour or so, they are still damp, even on the extended cyle. and the dry cycle on high. The DW has always smelled a bit off. I replaced my Maytag DW that was more than 25 years old with this Bosch, and had used it regularly for the 15 years after moving into my current home. That Maytag cleaned and dried my dishes perfectly, and only once had a bad odor, which left after running a cleaning agent in it once. I was so sad to have to replace it after a bottom corner rusted out. Not once did it need servicing. I would rather to my dishes by hand that to have spent the money to buy this Bosch. In fact, I might as well do them, as I always have to wash several by hand and scrape residue from several that have essentially hardened from the heat. The picture below shows the drying result without Rinse Aid, and also the hazy bottom of a glass, which clears up when I scrub it better. I absolutely hate this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I have zero complaints about this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ The Best Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I have zero complaints about this dishwasher. It's the best dishwasher I've ever owned (which may not be saying much, but still). Dishes always come out spotless and dry (esp. with the Crystal Dry feature); it's super easy to use; and at 42db, it's virtually SILENT. I had to hunt around a little for the dishwasher salt, but found some online. Note that you end up using about 1/2 a box of it. And don't skip that part, because I'm sure that it plays a role in how spotless the dishes come out. (If you're unsure about your area's water hardness, buy a test kit for cheap and/or call your local water utility service.) If you're wondering, the app is not necessary in order to run the dishwasher, but some of the settings are easier to program with it, otherwise you're following the instructions and pushing a bunch of buttons a bunch of times to get to the setting you want vs. just setting it directly in the app. But after that initial setup, I hardly ever look at the app. In fact, you could probably install it just for setup then delete it if you wanted to. I didn't think I'd favor using the top (3rd) rack for utensils vs. the standard basket in the bottom rack, but as it turns out, I do, and have virtually eliminated the utensil basket in the lower section, which leaves more room for pots & pans and larger bowls and stuff. Perhaps the only con is that I ended up purchasing a small basket for my stainless steel straws so they could stand upright, and I use that in the 2nd/middle rack. I've only had this dishwasher for a couple months, so I can't speak to longevity, but it runs so smoothly, I don't have any concerns. If you're considering getting a Bosch dishwasher on any level, just do it! You don't be disappointed.

Sentence (English): I don't understand why I have to write about what and why I don't like Home Connect.
Comments (English): [ Useful application ] || ---------------- || I don't understand why I have to write about what and why I don't like Home Connect. I'd rather describe the good things: my dishwasher doesn't have a display on the outside, so I can't see how much time is left in the program. I would really miss this, because I was able to track this easily with my other types of machines. But with this option, you can also know where the program is with the Bosch device. It's a big help that it writes out other information (e.g. when to replace salt or fabric softener) and I also get other recommendations. I haven't used the cookbook yet, but I think I can find good ideas there. I think it's a good idea. What makes me sadder is that, despite the fact that we spent a small fortune on my kitchen equipment (refrigerator, oven, microwave, induction hob), it did not turn out to be a smart kitchen. The dealer (not Multi) told me afterwards that although there is a smart function in previous devices as well as in the current ones, it was not installed in ours due to the lack of a chip. Of course, if he had indicated this, then we would have waited, because nowadays online control is standard. This is mostly a problem with the oven, because this way I can't remotely start the preparation of the already prepared food, so that by the time the family gets home, a ready, hot dinner is waiting for us. We were advised to visit the service center and ask if it can be installed afterwards. But please! We bought the devices 2 months ago, and now we should run to the service center? This is a big disappointment for me, which also affects my feelings towards Bosch, even though I know you are not responsible for this mistake. In any case, I like and use the dishwasher application. I'm glad I can use it at least in that.

Comments (English): [ Highly rated, energy efficient but has some flaws. ] || ---------------- || Our old GE unit finally died and we replaced it with this highly rated unit. The Bosch requires a dishtowel in hand when unloading as many things are still a little wet (even after I pressed the "extra dry" button). The GE grinder growled for about 2 minutes at the start of washing and was no more annoying than a microwave . Comments (English): [ Disappoints in every way ] || ---------------- || I purchased this Bosch 100 Series Model SHE3AEM2N, confident of its reliability and superior quality, based on Bosch's long-standing excellent reputation for excellent products. I paid $699.99, excluding tax and delivery. When delivered, there was a dent on the top, despite good packaging. The first problem was my dishes were left sopping wet with cloudy water, as was the entire interior, with puddling on the bottom. The service men I called were not Bosch specialists, but immediately informed me that a rinsing agent (not cheap) was necessary to dry the dishes. The manual states "for OPTIMAL [drying] results, add rinse aid". That is not only blatantly misleading, it is laughable, considering my accurate and unembellished description above. It also completely fails to address that the "nonoptimal' drying involves leaving a cloudy liquid all over the inside.Despite rinsing and scrubbing my dishes and flatware to remove food residue, using an approved liquid DW detergent and the same Rinse Aid product the came with the DW, they routinely come out with lightly soiled. Unless I leave the door opened for an hour or so, they are still damp, even on the extended cyle. and the dry cycle on high. The DW has always smelled a bit off.I replaced my Maytag DW that was more than 25 years old with this Bosch, and had used it regularly for the 15 years after moving into my current home. That Maytag cleaned and dried my dishes perfectly, and only once had a bad odor, which left after running a cleaning agent in it once. I was so sad to have to replace it after a bottom corner rusted out. Not once did it need servicing.I would rather to my dishes by hand that to have spent the money to buy this Bosch. In fact, I might as well do them, as I always have to wash several by hand and scrape residue from several that have essentially hardened from the heat. The picture below shows the drying result without Rinse Aid, and also the hazy bottom of a glass, which clears up when I scrub it better. I absolutely hate this dishwasher.

No reason to worry. ] || ---------------- || After seeing this product on Coupang, I was wondering if I should buy a famous brand dishwasher from a large company, so I just put it in my shopping cart. However, one day, the name of the company that made this product was written on the back of the famous brand dishwasher that I was interested in. The price was about a third of that. And since all the reviews were good, there was no reason to hesitate anymore. I bought it right away and installed it the next day. Because of the problem with the marble countertop in our kitchen, we couldn't build it in, so we installed it neatly by connecting a long hose between the kitchen and the utility room. Since the dishwasher-specific detergent (Frog) hadn't arrived yet, I just ran it on eco mode twice without detergent. 1. I was surprised that all the dishes were cleaned so cleanly. 2. I was surprised that it was so quiet. I turned around a few times to see if it was really spinning. 3. Someone was worried that the cleaning power would be low because there were only two rotating blades, but two were enough. 4. It is bigger than you think and the interior is spacious, so you can put in a day's worth of dishes at once and put in pots and frying pans without any problems. 5. If you use the drying mode, it dries neatly and the door remains open. 6. The cutlery holder is large, so you can put in all the cutlery sets and still have some left over (you have to put chopsticks on both ends of the spoon holder. The chopsticks fall out in the middle). 7. You can take a nap after running the dishwasher. There is no reason not to buy it.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher in order to have a top of the line appliance that would last us many years and help with the resale value of our home someday.
Comments (English): [ New Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher in order to have a top of the line appliance that would last us many years and help with the resale value of our home someday. We love how quiet it is! You hardly know it's running. :) It does a fine job but we still rinse off most food before we put the dishes in because that's our habit. We do notice an odor like spoiled milk when dirty dishes are sitting in the unit waiting for a full load. Since there are only two of us using it, it takes a few days to completely fill it to run. I think it closes so tightly that there's no venting for food breakdown on the unwashed dishes. I believe it might be worse if we didn't rinse off most of the food before putting the dishes in the washer. I wish there was a way to leave it cracked open to vent but it sticks out too far when it opens. We're experimenting with how to load it. Still figuring out what works best. Overall, we're satisfied with it. :)

Sentence (English): I decided to buy a dishwasher at the recommendation of my acquaintances, and I decided to buy it along with the Styler, attracted by the discount on multiple items.

Sentence (English): It's really easy to install.
Comments (English): [ It's really easy to install. Just place the main unit on a water tank and attach two hoses. After filling the included beaker with water about 3 times, it comes up completely. I tested it right away and it was able to clean light dishes. ] || ---------------- || It's really easy to install. Just place the main unit on a water tank and attach the two hoses. After filling the included beaker with water about 3 times, it's full. I tested it right away, and light dishes were washed cleanly. Even the frying pan with oil came out clean. Although it says it's for 1-3 people, it's not spacious enough to handle all the pots, pans, and dishes from a single-person household at once. I want to make this review as useful as possible. in the past few years, I replaced my dishwasher twice, from an old GE to a new GE, which broke after a year (my fault), to this model of Samsung linear dishwasher. What amazes me about this model is how BAD is it.This item CANNOT dry dishes. 1️⃣ it doesn't have hot air, which is a must, I know it now after using GE appliances. but that's ok, maybe if we have a fan? 2️⃣ It has a fan that can ONLY operate for 10 minutes. What? no option to run it longer? Everything comes out wet, on the sides on the top. I had a tech check it, and they said that it could be low hot water temperature in our pipes, which we checked and we have an adequate temperature, so tech left without doing anything.Dishes consistently come out dirty, I tried longer cycles, different soap, lighter loads. pre-washing dishes by hand. Something about the linear system is not working. Disclaimer, I'm not saying it doesn't clean, it does. But in each load there will be a few bowls that didn't clean, maybe a chunk of food stuck on the wall, red food coloring, and before you say that this is probably something really hard to get rid of. No, with dish soap and sponge, i can finish the job in just a few swipes. ⁉️I'm amazed how well-ranked this item is: it is quiet you say. You must have not used any dishwasher lately, do you? 39db is quiet, but after trying a GE, which hadn't made any claims about how silent it was, I can tell you confidently that 39db machine did not improve on the noise level.

Sentence (English): I've been using a 6-person dishwasher for the past 5 years, but this time I made up my mind and changed to a large capacity.
Comments (English): [ It's the best ] || ---------------- || I've been using a 6-person dishwasher for the past 5 years, but this time I made up my mind and changed to a large capacity. Even though we don't have a large family, it's so convenient because I only have to run it once a day, and it can hold everything from pots to large frying pans. And the price is very reasonable, and it's usable even without the hot air drying function. It has a strong drying button, so everything dries well. Since I got the dishwasher, the time I spend washing dishes has been reduced by 1 hour. It's a great product and it's so cost-effective, so I highly recommend it. And I feel so good and happy every time I see the Cota White color that goes so well with the interior. I have no regrets choosing Samsung, which has good after-sales service! In fact, while using the 6-person one, the space was so lacking that I had to rotate it several times a day and had a hard time putting it in and taking it out. But after purchasing the 14-person one instead of the 12-person one, it's a whole new world. It's like my aunt who has a lot of food has come into my house, so housework has become a lot easier. The black one was discounted more, but I think it was a good idea to go with the white one. I think it gives a luxurious feel without standing out in the interior no matter where I move, so I highly recommend the color. Cooking at home has become more enjoyable these days. I really didn't want to cook because of the dishes, but this is so convenient! And what surprised me the most was that there was no installation cost at all, and even the remodeling cost was included. It's a Samsung Electronics product, so I was really surprised that the price was this much. By adding more space, the washing sprays, there are TWO rotating spray arms…not one, are really a "pot scrubber" cleaner. A simple apple corer requires a bit of scrubbing after a months use. Sentence (English): I've had this a little under a month and so far I am happy with the performance.
Comments (English): I've had this a little under a month and so far I am happy with the performance. My wife's biggest complaint about dishwashers in general is that they are too loud. This one is definitely whisper quiet. Dishes get very clean, and I like the various cycles I can choose, including a short 1-hour cycle that is great for holiday gatherings so I can run the dishwasher quickly and get to the next set of dirty dishes. I'm still on the fence about the usefulness of the 3rd rack. It can come in handy but it does reduce the height of the top rack to the point where things that would easily fit in my old dishwasher must now go on the lower rack. I've used the bottle jets only once but it did a nice job getting to places regular spray jets could not. Overall I'd recommend this if anyone asked me.

I am so glad we bought this model. If it's remotely in your price range, buy it!
